63 // Translate an arg-style path (POSIX-or-Win32, UTF-8) to a native
64 // filesystem::path. On Windows we route through wide strings so the
65 // UTF-8 bytes don't get mojibake'd through the active codepage by
66 // the default `path(string)` constructor (`Tomáš` -> `TomÃ¡Å¡`).
67 static fs::path toNative(Executor& exec, const std::string& p) {
68 return utf8ToPath(exec.pathConv().toWin32(p));
69 }
70
71 // fopen on a UTF-8, POSIX-or-Win32 path. Routes through `_wfopen`
72 // on Windows so non-ASCII filenames survive intact.
73 static std::FILE* fopenNative(Executor& exec, const std::string& p, const char* mode) {
74 return openUtf8(exec.pathConv().toWin32(p), mode);
75 }

99 static int consoleWidth() {
100#ifdef _WIN32
101 HANDLE h = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
102 CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO info{};
103 if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo(h, &info)) {
104 int w = info.srWindow.Right - info.srWindow.Left + 1;
105 if (w > 0) return w;
106 }
107#endif
108 return 80;
109 }

111 struct LsEntry {
112 std::string name;
113 fs::path full;
114 fs::file_status status{};
115 std::uintmax_t size = 0;
116 fs::file_time_type mtime{};
117 bool is_dir = false;
118 bool is_symlink = false;
119 bool is_executable = false;
120 bool is_hidden = false;
121 bool valid = false;
122 };
123
124 static bool windowsHidden(const fs::path& p) {
125#ifdef _WIN32
126 DWORD attr = GetFileAttributesW(p.wstring().c_str());
127 if (attr == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return false;
128 return (attr & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN) != 0;
129#else
130 (void)p;
131 return false;
132#endif
133 }
134
135 LsEntry collect(const fs::path& parent, const std::string& name) {
136 LsEntry e;
137 e.name = name;
138 fs::path npath = utf8ToPath(name);
139 e.full = parent.empty() ? npath : (parent / npath);
140 std::error_code ec;
141 e.status = fs::symlink_status(e.full, ec);
142 e.is_symlink = !ec && fs::is_symlink(e.status);
143 fs::file_status real = e.is_symlink
144 ? fs::status(e.full, ec)
145 : e.status;
146 e.is_dir = !ec && fs::is_directory(real);
147 if (!ec && fs::is_regular_file(e.status)) {
148 e.size = fs::file_size(e.full, ec);
149 if (ec) e.size = 0;
150 }
151 std::error_code ec2;
152 e.mtime = fs::last_write_time(e.full, ec2);
153 // Hidden: leading dot OR Windows hidden attribute.
154 if (!name.empty() && name[0] == '.') e.is_hidden = true;
155 if (windowsHidden(e.full)) e.is_hidden = true;
156 // Executable heuristic on Windows: extension.
157 std::string ext = pathToUtf8(e.full.extension());
158 std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(),
159 [](char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c)); });
160 if (ext == ".exe" || ext == ".bat" || ext == ".cmd" || ext == ".com" || ext == ".ps1") {
161 e.is_executable = true;
162 }
163 e.valid = true;
164 return e;
165 }
166
167 static std::string colorize(const LsEntry& e, bool use_color) {
168 if (!use_color) return e.name;
169 const char* code = nullptr;
170 if (e.is_symlink) code = "\x1b[36;1m"; // cyan
171 else if (e.is_dir) code = "\x1b[34;1m"; // blue
172 else if (e.is_executable) code = "\x1b[32;1m"; // green
173 if (!code) return e.name;
174 return std::string(code) + e.name + "\x1b[0m";
175 }
176
177 static std::string classifySuffix(const LsEntry& e) {
178 if (e.is_dir) return "/";
179 if (e.is_symlink) return "@";
180 if (e.is_executable) return "*";
181 return "";
182 }

184 static std::string humanSize(std::uintmax_t n) {
185 static const char* units[] = { "", "K", "M", "G", "T", "P" };
186 double v = static_cast<double>(n);
187 int u = 0;
188 while (v >= 1024.0 && u + 1 < static_cast<int>(sizeof(units) / sizeof(units[0]))) {
189 v /= 1024.0;
190 ++u;
191 }
192 char buf[32];
193 if (u == 0) {
194 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", static_cast<unsigned long long>(n));
195 }
196 else if (v >= 10.0) {
197 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.0f%s", v, units[u]);
198 }
199 else {
200 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.1f%s", v, units[u]);
201 }
202 return buf;
203 }
204
205 static std::string formatMtime(const fs::file_time_type& t) {
206 using namespace std::chrono;
207 auto sctp = time_point_cast<system_clock::duration>(
208 t - fs::file_time_type::clock::now() + system_clock::now());
209 std::time_t tt = system_clock::to_time_t(sctp);
210 std::tm tm{};
211#ifdef _WIN32
212 localtime_s(&tm, &tt);
213#else
214 localtime_r(&tt, &tm);
215#endif
216 // Match GNU ls: month day time-or-year. For the past 6 months, show
217 // time; otherwise show year. Cheap version: always show YYYY-MM-DD.
218 char buf[32];
219 std::strftime(buf, sizeof(buf), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", &tm);
220 return buf;
221 }

223 static std::string permString(const LsEntry& e) {
224 std::string s;
225 s += e.is_symlink ? 'l' : (e.is_dir ? 'd' : '-');
226 // Best-effort rwx — Windows lacks POSIX bits; we approximate.
227 bool readonly = false;
228#ifdef _WIN32
229 DWORD attr = GetFileAttributesW(e.full.wstring().c_str());
230 if (attr != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
231 readonly = (attr & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0;
232 }
233#endif
234 s += "r";
235 s += (readonly ? "-" : "w");
236 s += (e.is_executable || e.is_dir) ? "x" : "-";
237 s += "r-";
238 s += (e.is_executable || e.is_dir) ? "x" : "-";
239 s += "r-";
240 s += (e.is_executable || e.is_dir) ? "x" : "-";
241 return s;
242 }

244 static void sortEntries(std::vector<LsEntry>& items, const LsOpts& opts) {
245 auto cmp_name = [](const LsEntry& a, const LsEntry& b) {
246 // Case-insensitive primary, case-sensitive tiebreak.
247 std::string al = a.name, bl = b.name;
248 std::transform(al.begin(), al.end(), al.begin(),
249 [](char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c)); });
250 std::transform(bl.begin(), bl.end(), bl.begin(),
251 [](char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c)); });
252 if (al != bl) return al < bl;
253 return a.name < b.name;
254 };
255 if (opts.sort_mtime) {
256 std::sort(items.begin(), items.end(),
257 [&](const LsEntry& a, const LsEntry& b) {
258 if (a.mtime != b.mtime) return a.mtime > b.mtime;
259 return cmp_name(a, b);
260 });
261 }
262 else if (opts.sort_size) {
263 std::sort(items.begin(), items.end(),
264 [&](const LsEntry& a, const LsEntry& b) {
265 if (a.size != b.size) return a.size > b.size;
266 return cmp_name(a, b);
267 });
268 }
269 else {
270 std::sort(items.begin(), items.end(), cmp_name);
271 }
272 if (opts.reverse) std::reverse(items.begin(), items.end());
273 }

275 static void printColumns(const std::vector<LsEntry>& items, const LsOpts& opts, bool use_color) {
276 if (items.empty()) return;
277 std::vector<std::string> labels;
278 labels.reserve(items.size());
279 std::size_t maxlen = 0;
280 for (const auto& e : items) {
281 std::string label = e.name + classifySuffix(e);
282 if (label.size() > maxlen) maxlen = label.size();
283 labels.push_back(std::move(label));
284 }
285 if (opts.one || !stdoutIsTty()) {
286 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < items.size(); ++i) {
287 if (use_color) std::fputs(colorize(items[i], true).c_str(), stdout);
288 else std::fputs(items[i].name.c_str(), stdout);
289 std::fputs(classifySuffix(items[i]).c_str(), stdout);
290 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
291 }
292 return;
293 }
294 int width = consoleWidth();
295 std::size_t pad = maxlen + 2;
296 std::size_t cols = std::max<std::size_t>(1, width / pad);
297 std::size_t rows = (items.size() + cols - 1) / cols;
298 for (std::size_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r) {
299 for (std::size_t c = 0; c < cols; ++c) {
300 std::size_t idx = c * rows + r;
301 if (idx >= items.size()) break;
302 std::string disp = use_color ? colorize(items[idx], true) : items[idx].name;
303 disp += classifySuffix(items[idx]);
304 std::fputs(disp.c_str(), stdout);
305 if (c + 1 < cols && (c + 1) * rows + r < items.size()) {
306 // Pad to column width using the *visible* label length.
307 std::size_t visible = labels[idx].size();
308 for (std::size_t k = visible; k < pad; ++k) std::fputc(' ', stdout);
309 }
310 }
311 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
312 }
313 }
314
315 static void printLong(const std::vector<LsEntry>& items, const LsOpts& opts, bool use_color, Executor& exec) {
316 std::string user = exec.env().get("USER");
317 if (user.empty()) user = exec.env().get("USERNAME");
318 if (user.empty()) user = "user";
319 // Compute column widths.
320 std::size_t size_w = 1;
321 for (const auto& e : items) {
322 std::string s = opts.human ? humanSize(e.size) : std::to_string(e.size);
323 if (s.size() > size_w) size_w = s.size();
324 }
325 for (const auto& e : items) {
326 std::string p = permString(e);
327 std::string s = opts.human ? humanSize(e.size) : std::to_string(e.size);
328 std::string mt = formatMtime(e.mtime);
329 std::string label = use_color ? colorize(e, true) : e.name;
330 label += classifySuffix(e);
331 // Pad size right-aligned.
332 std::string spad(size_w - s.size(), ' ');
333 std::fprintf(stdout, "%s 1 %s %s %s%s %s %s\n",
334 p.c_str(), user.c_str(), user.c_str(),
335 spad.c_str(), s.c_str(), mt.c_str(), label.c_str());
336 }
337 }

339 static int builtin_ls(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
340 LsOpts opts;
341 std::vector<std::string> paths;
342 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
343 const std::string& a = args[i];
344 if (a == "--") {
345 for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) paths.push_back(args[i]);
346 break;
347 }
348 if (a == "--color" || a == "--color=auto") opts.color = LsOpts::Auto;
349 else if (a == "--color=always" || a == "--color=yes") opts.color = LsOpts::Always;
350 else if (a == "--color=never" || a == "--color=no") opts.color = LsOpts::Never;
351 else if (a == "--all") opts.all = true;
352 else if (a == "--human-readable") opts.human = true;
353 else if (a == "--reverse") opts.reverse = true;
354 else if (a == "--classify") opts.classify = true;
355 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
356 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
357 switch (a[k]) {
358 case 'a': case 'A': opts.all = true; break;
359 case 'l': opts.long_fmt = true; break;
360 case '1': opts.one = true; break;
361 case 'h': opts.human = true; break;
362 case 'r': opts.reverse = true; break;
363 case 't': opts.sort_mtime = true; break;
364 case 'S': opts.sort_size = true; break;
365 case 'F': opts.classify = true; break;
366 default:
367 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: ls: unknown option -%c\n", a[k]);
368 return 2;
369 }
370 }
371 }
372 else {
373 paths.push_back(a);
374 }
375 }
376 if (paths.empty()) paths.push_back(".");
377
378 bool use_color = (opts.color == LsOpts::Always)
379 || (opts.color == LsOpts::Auto && stdoutIsTty());
380 // classify is implicit with -F; otherwise off.
381 bool classify_set = opts.classify;
382 (void)classify_set;
383
384 int rc = 0;
385 bool show_headers = paths.size() > 1;
386 for (std::size_t pi = 0; pi < paths.size(); ++pi) {
387 const std::string& p = paths[pi];
388 fs::path target = toNative(exec, p);
389 std::error_code ec;
390 fs::file_status st = fs::symlink_status(target, ec);
391 if (ec) {
392 perr("ls", p, ec);
393 rc = 1;
394 continue;
395 }
396 std::vector<LsEntry> items;
397 if (fs::is_directory(st)) {
398 if (show_headers) {
399 if (pi) std::fputc('\n', stdout);
400 std::fprintf(stdout, "%s:\n", p.c_str());
401 }
402 fs::directory_iterator it(target, ec);
403 if (ec) { perr("ls", p, ec); rc = 1; continue; }
404 for (const auto& de : it) {
405 std::string name;
406 try { name = pathToUtf8(de.path().filename()); }
407 catch (...) { continue; }
408 LsEntry e = collect(target, name);
409 if (!opts.all && e.is_hidden) continue;
410 items.push_back(std::move(e));
411 }
412 }
413 else {
414 LsEntry e = collect(fs::path(), p);
415 e.name = p; // preserve user-supplied spelling
416 items.push_back(std::move(e));
417 }
418 sortEntries(items, opts);
419 if (opts.long_fmt) {
420 std::uintmax_t total_blocks = 0;
421 (void)total_blocks;
422 printLong(items, opts, use_color, exec);
423 }
424 else {
425 printColumns(items, opts, use_color);
426 }
427 }
428 std::fflush(stdout);
429 return rc;
430 }

434 static int builtin_cat(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
435 bool number = false;
436 bool number_nonblank = false;
437 std::vector<std::string> files;
438 std::size_t i = 0;
439 while (i < args.size()) {
440 const std::string& a = args[i];
441 if (a == "--") { ++i; while (i < args.size()) files.push_back(args[i++]); break; }
442 if (a == "-n" || a == "--number") { number = true; ++i; continue; }
443 if (a == "-b" || a == "--number-nonblank") { number_nonblank = true; ++i; continue; }
444 if (a == "-") { files.push_back("-"); ++i; continue; }
445 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
446 bool ok = true;
447 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
448 if (a[k] == 'n') number = true;
449 else if (a[k] == 'b') number_nonblank = true;
450 else { ok = false; break; }
451 }
452 if (ok) { ++i; continue; }
453 }
454 files.push_back(a);
455 ++i;
456 }
457 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
458
459 int rc = 0;
460 std::size_t lineno = 0;
461 auto emit_chunk = [&](const char* data, std::size_t n) {
462 if (!number && !number_nonblank) {
463 std::fwrite(data, 1, n, stdout);
464 return;
465 }
466 // Line-aware emit: track lines, prepend numbers when appropriate.
467 static thread_local bool at_line_start = true;
468 static thread_local std::string pending;
469 for (std::size_t p = 0; p < n; ++p) {
470 if (at_line_start) {
471 bool blank_line = (p < n && (data[p] == '\n'));
472 if (number_nonblank) {
473 if (!blank_line) {
474 ++lineno;
475 std::fprintf(stdout, "%6zu\t", lineno);
476 }
477 }
478 else {
479 ++lineno;
480 std::fprintf(stdout, "%6zu\t", lineno);
481 }
482 at_line_start = false;
483 }
484 std::fputc(data[p], stdout);
485 if (data[p] == '\n') at_line_start = true;
486 }
487 };
488
489 for (const auto& f : files) {
490 if (f == "-") {
491 char buf[4096];
492 while (true) {
493 std::size_t got = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
494 if (got == 0) break;
495 emit_chunk(buf, got);
496 }
497 continue;
498 }
499 fs::path native = toNative(exec, f);
500 std::ifstream in(native, std::ios::binary);
501 if (!in) {
502 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: cat: %s: %s\n",
503 f.c_str(), std::strerror(errno));
504 rc = 1;
505 continue;
506 }
507 char buf[4096];
508 while (in) {
509 in.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
510 std::streamsize got = in.gcount();
511 if (got > 0) emit_chunk(buf, static_cast<std::size_t>(got));
512 }
513 }
514 std::fflush(stdout);
515 return rc;
516 }

529 static int builtin_which(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
530 int rc = 0;
531 for (const auto& name : args) {
532 if (exec.isFunction(name)) {
533 std::printf("%s: shell function\n", name.c_str());
534 continue;
535 }
536 if (exec.isBuiltin(name)) {
537 std::printf("%s: shell builtin\n", name.c_str());
538 continue;
539 }
540 std::string path = exec.env().get("PATH");
541 bool found = false;
542 std::vector<std::string> dirs;
543 std::string cur;
544 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < path.size(); ++k) {
545 char c = path[k];
546 if (c == ';') { dirs.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); }
547 else if (c == ':') {
548 if (cur.size() == 1 && std::isalpha((unsigned char)cur[0])) cur.push_back(c);
549 else { dirs.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); }
550 }
551 else cur.push_back(c);
552 }
553 if (!cur.empty()) dirs.push_back(cur);
554 for (const auto& d : dirs) {
555 if (d.empty()) continue;
556 fs::path base = utf8ToPath(exec.pathConv().toWin32(d));
557#ifdef _WIN32
558 static const char* exts[] = { "", ".exe", ".cmd", ".bat", nullptr };
559#else
560 static const char* exts[] = { "", nullptr };
561#endif
562 for (int e = 0; exts[e]; ++e) {
563 fs::path q = base / utf8ToPath(name + exts[e]);
564 std::error_code ec;
565 if (fs::exists(q, ec) && !fs::is_directory(q, ec)) {
566 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(q)).c_str());
567 found = true;
568 break;
569 }
570 }
571 if (found) break;
572 }
573 if (!found) {
574 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: which: %s: not found\n", name.c_str());
575 rc = 1;
576 }
577 }
578 return rc;
579 }

583 static int builtin_mkdir(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
584 bool parents = false;
585 std::vector<std::string> paths;
586 for (const auto& a : args) {
587 if (a == "-p" || a == "--parents") parents = true;
588 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
589 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) if (a[k] == 'p') parents = true;
590 }
591 else paths.push_back(a);
592 }
593 if (paths.empty()) { perr("mkdir", "missing operand"); return 1; }
594 int rc = 0;
595 for (const auto& p : paths) {
596 std::error_code ec;
597 fs::path nat(toNative(exec, p));
598 bool ok = parents ? fs::create_directories(nat, ec)
599 : fs::create_directory(nat, ec);
600 if (ec) { perr("mkdir", p, ec); rc = 1; }
601 else if (!ok && !parents) { perr("mkdir", p + ": already exists"); rc = 1; }
602 }
603 return rc;
604 }

606 static int builtin_rmdir(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
607 if (args.empty()) { perr("rmdir", "missing operand"); return 1; }
608 int rc = 0;
609 for (const auto& p : args) {
610 std::error_code ec;
611 fs::path nat(toNative(exec, p));
612 if (!fs::remove(nat, ec)) {
613 if (ec) perr("rmdir", p, ec);
614 else perr("rmdir", p + ": failed");
615 rc = 1;
616 }
617 }
618 return rc;
619 }

621 static int builtin_rm(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
622 bool recursive = false, force = false;
623 std::vector<std::string> paths;
624 for (const auto& a : args) {
625 if (a == "-r" || a == "-R" || a == "--recursive") recursive = true;
626 else if (a == "-f" || a == "--force") force = true;
627 else if (a == "-rf" || a == "-fr" || a == "-Rf" || a == "-fR") { recursive = true; force = true; }
628 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
629 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
630 if (a[k] == 'r' || a[k] == 'R') recursive = true;
631 else if (a[k] == 'f') force = true;
632 }
633 }
634 else paths.push_back(a);
635 }
636 if (paths.empty()) {
637 if (!force) { perr("rm", "missing operand"); return 1; }
638 return 0;
639 }
640 int rc = 0;
641 for (const auto& p : paths) {
642 std::error_code ec;
643 fs::path nat(toNative(exec, p));
644 if (!fs::exists(nat, ec)) {
645 if (!force) { perr("rm", p + ": no such file or directory"); rc = 1; }
646 continue;
647 }
648 if (recursive) {
649 std::uintmax_t n = fs::remove_all(nat, ec);
650 if (ec && !force) { perr("rm", p, ec); rc = 1; }
651 (void)n;
652 }
653 else {
654 if (fs::is_directory(nat, ec)) {
655 perr("rm", p + ": is a directory");
656 rc = 1;
657 continue;
658 }
659 if (!fs::remove(nat, ec)) {
660 if (!force) { perr("rm", p, ec); rc = 1; }
661 }
662 }
663 }
664 return rc;
665 }
666
667 static int builtin_cp(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
668 bool recursive = false;
669 std::vector<std::string> paths;
670 for (const auto& a : args) {
671 if (a == "-r" || a == "-R" || a == "--recursive") recursive = true;
672 else if (a == "-a") recursive = true; // archive (we treat as -r)
673 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
674 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
675 if (a[k] == 'r' || a[k] == 'R') recursive = true;
676 }
677 }
678 else paths.push_back(a);
679 }
680 if (paths.size() < 2) { perr("cp", "missing source/destination"); return 1; }
681 fs::path dst(toNative(exec, paths.back()));
682 std::error_code ec;
683 bool dst_is_dir = fs::is_directory(dst, ec);
684 int rc = 0;
685 for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < paths.size(); ++i) {
686 fs::path src(toNative(exec, paths[i]));
687 fs::path target = dst_is_dir ? (dst / src.filename()) : dst;
688 std::error_code copy_ec;
689 auto opts = fs::copy_options::overwrite_existing;
690 if (recursive) opts = opts | fs::copy_options::recursive
691 | fs::copy_options::copy_symlinks;
692 fs::copy(src, target, opts, copy_ec);
693 if (copy_ec) { perr("cp", paths[i], copy_ec); rc = 1; }
694 }
695 return rc;
696 }
697
698 static int builtin_mv(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
699 std::vector<std::string> paths;
700 for (const auto& a : args) {
701 if (a == "--") continue;
702 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-' && a != "-") continue; // ignore unknown flags
703 paths.push_back(a);
704 }
705 if (paths.size() < 2) { perr("mv", "missing source/destination"); return 1; }
706 fs::path dst(toNative(exec, paths.back()));
707 std::error_code ec;
708 bool dst_is_dir = fs::is_directory(dst, ec);
709 int rc = 0;
710 for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < paths.size(); ++i) {
711 fs::path src(toNative(exec, paths[i]));
712 fs::path target = dst_is_dir ? (dst / src.filename()) : dst;
713 std::error_code mv_ec;
714 fs::rename(src, target, mv_ec);
715 if (mv_ec) {
716 // Cross-device or other rename failure: fall back to copy + remove.
717 std::error_code cp_ec;
718 fs::copy(src, target, fs::copy_options::overwrite_existing
719 | fs::copy_options::recursive | fs::copy_options::copy_symlinks, cp_ec);
720 if (cp_ec) { perr("mv", paths[i], cp_ec); rc = 1; continue; }
721 std::error_code rm_ec;
722 fs::remove_all(src, rm_ec);
723 if (rm_ec) { perr("mv", paths[i], rm_ec); rc = 1; }
724 }
725 }
726 return rc;
727 }
728
729 static int builtin_touch(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
730 if (args.empty()) { perr("touch", "missing operand"); return 1; }
731 int rc = 0;
732 for (const auto& p : args) {
733 if (!p.empty() && p[0] == '-' && p != "-") continue; // skip flags
734 fs::path nat = toNative(exec, p);
735 std::error_code ec;
736 if (!fs::exists(nat, ec)) {
737 std::ofstream f(nat, std::ios::binary | std::ios::app);
738 if (!f) { perr("touch", p + ": cannot create"); rc = 1; continue; }
739 }
740 else {
741 auto now = fs::file_time_type::clock::now();
742 fs::last_write_time(nat, now, ec);
743 if (ec) { perr("touch", p, ec); rc = 1; }
744 }
745 }
746 return rc;
747 }
748
749 // ---- head / tail / wc ------------------------------------------------
750
751 static int parseNumFlag(const std::vector<std::string>& args, const char* short_flag,
752 std::size_t& i, long& out) {
753 const std::string& a = args[i];
754 if (a.size() > 2 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] == short_flag[0] && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[2])) {
755 try { out = std::stol(a.substr(2)); ++i; return 0; }
756 catch (...) { return -1; }
757 }
758 if (a == short_flag || a == std::string("-") + short_flag) {
759 if (i + 1 >= args.size()) return -1;
760 try { out = std::stol(args[i + 1]); i += 2; return 0; }
761 catch (...) { return -1; }
762 }
763 return 1;
764 }
765
766 static int builtin_head(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
767 long n = 10;
768 std::vector<std::string> files;
769 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ) {
770 const std::string& a = args[i];
771 if (a == "-n" || a.rfind("-n", 0) == 0) {
772 std::size_t j = i;
773 int r = parseNumFlag(args, "n", j, n);
774 if (r == 0) { i = j; continue; }
775 if (r == -1) { perr("head", "bad -n value"); return 1; }
776 }
777 if (a == "--") { for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) files.push_back(args[i]); break; }
778 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[1])) {
779 try { n = std::stol(a.substr(1)); }
780 catch (...) { perr("head", "bad N"); return 1; }
781 ++i; continue;
782 }
783 files.push_back(a);
784 ++i;
785 }
786 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
787 int rc = 0;
788 for (const auto& f : files) {
789 FILE* fp = (f == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, f, "rb");
790 if (!fp) { perr("head", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); rc = 1; continue; }
791 long printed = 0;
792 int c;
793 while (printed < n && (c = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) {
794 std::fputc(c, stdout);
795 if (c == '\n') ++printed;
796 }
797 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
798 }
799 std::fflush(stdout);
800 return rc;
801 }
802
803 static int builtin_tail(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
804 long n = 10;
805 std::vector<std::string> files;
806 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ) {
807 const std::string& a = args[i];
808 if (a == "-n" || a.rfind("-n", 0) == 0) {
809 std::size_t j = i;
810 int r = parseNumFlag(args, "n", j, n);
811 if (r == 0) { i = j; continue; }
812 if (r == -1) { perr("tail", "bad -n value"); return 1; }
813 }
814 if (a == "--") { for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) files.push_back(args[i]); break; }
815 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[1])) {
816 try { n = std::stol(a.substr(1)); }
817 catch (...) { perr("tail", "bad N"); return 1; }
818 ++i; continue;
819 }
820 files.push_back(a);
821 ++i;
822 }
823 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
824 int rc = 0;
825 for (const auto& f : files) {
826 std::vector<std::string> lines;
827 FILE* fp = (f == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, f, "rb");
828 if (!fp) { perr("tail", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); rc = 1; continue; }
829 std::string cur;
830 int c;
831 while ((c = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) {
832 if (c == '\n') {
833 lines.push_back(std::move(cur));
834 cur.clear();
835 }
836 else cur.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
837 }
838 if (!cur.empty()) lines.push_back(std::move(cur));
839 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
840 std::size_t start = (lines.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(n))
841 ? lines.size() - static_cast<std::size_t>(n) : 0;
842 for (std::size_t k = start; k < lines.size(); ++k) {
843 std::fputs(lines[k].c_str(), stdout);
844 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
845 }
846 }
847 std::fflush(stdout);
848 return rc;
849 }
850
851 static int builtin_wc(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
852 bool want_l = false, want_w = false, want_c = false, want_m = false;
853 std::vector<std::string> files;
854 for (const auto& a : args) {
855 if (a == "--") continue;
856 if (a == "-l" || a == "--lines") { want_l = true; continue; }
857 if (a == "-w" || a == "--words") { want_w = true; continue; }
858 if (a == "-c" || a == "--bytes") { want_c = true; continue; }
859 if (a == "-m" || a == "--chars") { want_m = true; continue; }
860 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
861 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
862 if (a[k] == 'l') want_l = true;
863 else if (a[k] == 'w') want_w = true;
864 else if (a[k] == 'c') want_c = true;
865 else if (a[k] == 'm') want_m = true;
866 }
867 continue;
868 }
869 files.push_back(a);
870 }
871 bool any = want_l || want_w || want_c || want_m;
872 if (!any) { want_l = want_w = want_c = true; }
873 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
874
875 std::uintmax_t total_l = 0, total_w = 0, total_c = 0, total_m = 0;
876 int rc = 0;
877 for (const auto& f : files) {
878 FILE* fp = (f == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, f, "rb");
879 if (!fp) { perr("wc", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); rc = 1; continue; }
880 std::uintmax_t l = 0, w = 0, c = 0, m = 0;
881 bool in_word = false;
882 int ch;
883 while ((ch = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) {
884 ++c;
885 if (static_cast<unsigned char>(ch) < 0x80
886 || (static_cast<unsigned char>(ch) & 0xC0) != 0x80) ++m;
887 if (ch == '\n') ++l;
888 if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))) {
889 in_word = false;
890 }
891 else if (!in_word) {
892 in_word = true;
893 ++w;
894 }
895 }
896 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
897 std::string out;
898 char buf[64];
899 if (want_l) { std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)l); out += buf; }
900 if (want_w) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)w); out += buf; }
901 if (want_m && !want_c) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)m); out += buf; }
902 if (want_c) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)c); out += buf; }
903 if (f != "-") { out += " "; out += f; }
904 out.push_back('\n');
905 std::fputs(out.c_str(), stdout);
906 total_l += l; total_w += w; total_c += c; total_m += m;
907 }
908 if (files.size() > 1) {
909 std::string out;
910 char buf[64];
911 if (want_l) { std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)total_l); out += buf; }
912 if (want_w) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)total_w); out += buf; }
913 if (want_m && !want_c) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)total_m); out += buf; }
914 if (want_c) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", (unsigned long long)total_c); out += buf; }
915 out += " total\n";
916 std::fputs(out.c_str(), stdout);
917 }
918 std::fflush(stdout);
919 return rc;
920 }

923
924 static int builtin_whoami(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>&) {
925 std::string u = exec.env().get("USER");
926 if (u.empty()) u = exec.env().get("USERNAME");
927 if (u.empty()) u = "user";
928 std::printf("%s\n", u.c_str());
929 return 0;

932 static int builtin_hostname(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>&) {
933 std::string h = exec.env().get("HOSTNAME");
934 if (h.empty()) h = exec.env().get("COMPUTERNAME");
935#ifdef _WIN32
936 if (h.empty()) {
937 char buf[256];
938 DWORD n = sizeof(buf);
939 if (GetComputerNameA(buf, &n)) h.assign(buf, n);
940 }
941#endif
942 std::printf("%s\n", h.c_str());
943 return 0;

945
946 static int builtin_env(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
947 // `env` with no args: print env. With `NAME=val ...` followed by a
948 // command: run command with overridden env. (Not implemented yet —
949 // we just print the merged set.)
950 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> sets;
951 std::vector<std::string> cmd;
952 for (const auto& a : args) {
953 if (cmd.empty() && a.find('=') != std::string::npos
954 && (std::isalpha((unsigned char)a[0]) || a[0] == '_')) {
955 auto eq = a.find('=');
956 sets.emplace_back(a.substr(0, eq), a.substr(eq + 1));
957 }
958 else {
959 cmd.push_back(a);
960 }
961 }
962 if (!cmd.empty()) {
963 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: env: running with overrides not yet implemented; "
964 "set then call directly\n");
965 return 1;
966 }
967 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> all(
968 exec.env().vars().begin(), exec.env().vars().end());
969 for (const auto& s : sets) {
970 bool found = false;
971 for (auto& kv : all) if (kv.first == s.first) { kv.second = s.second; found = true; break; }
972 if (!found) all.push_back(s);
973 }
974 std::sort(all.begin(), all.end());
975 for (const auto& kv : all) {
976 if (!exec.env().isExported(kv.first)) continue;
977 std::printf("%s=%s\n", kv.first.c_str(), kv.second.c_str());
978 }
979 return 0;
980 }
981
982 static int builtin_sleep(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
983 if (args.empty()) { perr("sleep", "missing operand"); return 1; }
984 double secs = 0.0;
985 try {
986 const std::string& a = args[0];
987 char suffix = (!a.empty()) ? a.back() : '\0';
988 std::string num = (suffix == 's' || suffix == 'm' || suffix == 'h')
989 ? a.substr(0, a.size() - 1) : a;
990 secs = std::stod(num);
991 if (suffix == 'm') secs *= 60.0;
992 else if (suffix == 'h') secs *= 3600.0;
993 }
994 catch (...) {
995 perr("sleep", args[0] + ": invalid time interval");
996 return 1;
997 }
998 std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(
999 static_cast<long long>(secs * 1000.0)));
1000 return 0;
1001 }
1002
1003 static int builtin_basename(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1004 if (args.empty()) { perr("basename", "missing operand"); return 1; }
1005 std::string s = args[0];
1006 while (s.size() > 1 && (s.back() == '/' || s.back() == '\\')) s.pop_back();
1007 auto pos = s.find_last_of("/\\");
1008 std::string name = (pos == std::string::npos) ? s : s.substr(pos + 1);
1009 if (args.size() > 1) {
1010 const std::string& suf = args[1];
1011 if (name.size() > suf.size()
1012 && name.compare(name.size() - suf.size(), suf.size(), suf) == 0) {
1013 name.resize(name.size() - suf.size());
1014 }
1015 }
1016 std::printf("%s\n", name.c_str());
1017 return 0;
1018 }
1019
1020 static int builtin_dirname(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1021 if (args.empty()) { perr("dirname", "missing operand"); return 1; }
1022 std::string s = args[0];
1023 while (s.size() > 1 && (s.back() == '/' || s.back() == '\\')) s.pop_back();
1024 auto pos = s.find_last_of("/\\");
1025 if (pos == std::string::npos) { std::printf(".\n"); return 0; }
1026 if (pos == 0) { std::printf("/\n"); return 0; }
1027 std::printf("%s\n", s.substr(0, pos).c_str());
1028 return 0;
1029 }
1030
1031 // ---- Common helpers for line-oriented builtins -----------------------
1032
1033 // Read all lines from a file (or stdin if path is "-"). Lines do NOT
1034 // include the terminating newline. A final unterminated line is
1035 // emitted as-is.
1036 static bool readAllLines(Executor& exec, const std::string& path,
1037 std::vector<std::string>& out) {
1038 FILE* fp = (path == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, path, "rb");
1039 if (!fp) return false;
1040 std::string cur;
1041 int c;
1042 while ((c = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) {
1043 if (c == '\n') { out.push_back(std::move(cur)); cur.clear(); }
1044 else cur.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
1045 }
1046 if (!cur.empty()) out.push_back(std::move(cur));
1047 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
1048 return true;
1049 }
1050
1051 // ---- sort ------------------------------------------------------------
1052
1053 static int builtin_sort(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1054 bool reverse = false, numeric = false, unique = false, fold = false;
1055 std::vector<std::string> files;
1056 for (const auto& a : args) {
1057 if (a == "--") continue;
1058 if (a == "-r" || a == "--reverse") reverse = true;
1059 else if (a == "-n" || a == "--numeric-sort") numeric = true;
1060 else if (a == "-u" || a == "--unique") unique = true;
1061 else if (a == "-f" || a == "--ignore-case") fold = true;
1062 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
1063 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
1064 switch (a[k]) {
1065 case 'r': reverse = true; break;
1066 case 'n': numeric = true; break;
1067 case 'u': unique = true; break;
1068 case 'f': fold = true; break;
1069 default:
1070 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: sort: unknown -%c\n", a[k]);
1071 return 2;
1072 }
1073 }
1074 }
1075 else files.push_back(a);
1076 }
1077 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1078 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1079 for (const auto& f : files) {
1080 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) {
1081 perr("sort", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
1082 return 2;
1083 }
1084 }
1085 auto fold_lower = [](std::string s) {
1086 for (char& c : s) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c));
1087 return s;
1088 };
1089 auto cmp = [&](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
1090 if (numeric) {
1091 double da = 0, db = 0;
1092 try { da = std::stod(a); }
1093 catch (...) {}
1094 try { db = std::stod(b); }
1095 catch (...) {}
1096 if (da != db) return da < db;
1097 return a < b;
1098 }
1099 if (fold) return fold_lower(a) < fold_lower(b);
1100 return a < b;
1101 };
1102 std::sort(lines.begin(), lines.end(), cmp);
1103 if (reverse) std::reverse(lines.begin(), lines.end());
1104 if (unique) {
1105 auto eq = [&](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
1106 if (fold) return fold_lower(a) == fold_lower(b);
1107 return a == b;
1108 };
1109 lines.erase(std::unique(lines.begin(), lines.end(), eq), lines.end());
1110 }
1111 for (const auto& l : lines) {
1112 std::fwrite(l.data(), 1, l.size(), stdout);
1113 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1114 }
1115 std::fflush(stdout);
1116 return 0;
1117 }
1118
1119 // ---- uniq (only dedupes ADJACENT duplicates, like real uniq) --------
1120
1121 static int builtin_uniq(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1122 bool count = false, dups_only = false, uniques_only = false, fold = false;
1123 std::vector<std::string> files;
1124 for (const auto& a : args) {
1125 if (a == "-c" || a == "--count") count = true;
1126 else if (a == "-d" || a == "--repeated") dups_only = true;
1127 else if (a == "-u" || a == "--unique") uniques_only = true;
1128 else if (a == "-i" || a == "--ignore-case") fold = true;
1129 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
1130 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
1131 switch (a[k]) {
1132 case 'c': count = true; break;
1133 case 'd': dups_only = true; break;
1134 case 'u': uniques_only = true; break;
1135 case 'i': fold = true; break;
1136 }
1137 }
1138 }
1139 else files.push_back(a);
1140 }
1141 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1142
1143 auto fold_lower = [](std::string s) {
1144 for (char& c : s) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c));
1145 return s;
1146 };
1147 auto eq = [&](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
1148 if (fold) return fold_lower(a) == fold_lower(b);
1149 return a == b;
1150 };
1151
1152 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1153 for (const auto& f : files) {
1154 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) {
1155 perr("uniq", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
1156 return 1;
1157 }
1158 }
1159 std::size_t i = 0;
1160 while (i < lines.size()) {
1161 std::size_t j = i + 1;
1162 while (j < lines.size() && eq(lines[j], lines[i])) ++j;
1163 int n = static_cast<int>(j - i);
1164 bool emit = true;
1165 if (dups_only && n < 2) emit = false;
1166 if (uniques_only && n > 1) emit = false;
1167 if (emit) {
1168 if (count) std::printf("%7d %s\n", n, lines[i].c_str());
1169 else std::printf("%s\n", lines[i].c_str());
1170 }
1171 i = j;
1172 }
1173 std::fflush(stdout);
1174 return 0;
1175 }
1176
1177 // ---- tr --------------------------------------------------------------
1178
1179 static std::string trExpandSet(const std::string& s) {
1180 std::string r;
1181 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
1182 if (s[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < s.size()) {
1183 char nx = s[++i];
1184 switch (nx) {
1185 case 'n': r.push_back('\n'); break;
1186 case 't': r.push_back('\t'); break;
1187 case 'r': r.push_back('\r'); break;
1188 case '\\': r.push_back('\\'); break;
1189 case 'a': r.push_back('\a'); break;
1190 case 'b': r.push_back('\b'); break;
1191 case '0': r.push_back('\0'); break;
1192 default: r.push_back(nx); break;
1193 }
1194 }
1195 else if (i + 2 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == '-') {
1196 char a = s[i], b = s[i + 2];
1197 if (a <= b) for (char c = a; c <= b; ++c) r.push_back(c);
1198 else for (char c = a; c >= b; --c) r.push_back(c);
1199 i += 2;
1200 }
1201 else {
1202 r.push_back(s[i]);
1203 }
1204 }
1205 return r;
1206 }
1207
1208 static int builtin_tr(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1209 bool delete_mode = false, squeeze = false, complement = false;
1210 std::vector<std::string> sets;
1211 for (const auto& a : args) {
1212 if (a == "-d") delete_mode = true;
1213 else if (a == "-s") squeeze = true;
1214 else if (a == "-c" || a == "-C" || a == "--complement") complement = true;
1215 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
1216 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
1217 if (a[k] == 'd') delete_mode = true;
1218 else if (a[k] == 's') squeeze = true;
1219 else if (a[k] == 'c' || a[k] == 'C') complement = true;
1220 }
1221 }
1222 else sets.push_back(a);
1223 }
1224 if (sets.empty() || (!delete_mode && !squeeze && sets.size() < 2)) {
1225 perr("tr", "usage: tr [-cds] SET1 [SET2]");
1226 return 2;
1227 }
1228 std::string s1 = trExpandSet(sets[0]);
1229 std::string s2 = (sets.size() > 1) ? trExpandSet(sets[1]) : std::string();
1230 std::vector<bool> in_s1(256, false);
1231 for (unsigned char c : s1) in_s1[c] = true;
1232 if (complement) {
1233 std::vector<bool> inv(256, true);
1234 for (int k = 0; k < 256; ++k) if (in_s1[k]) inv[k] = false;
1235 in_s1 = std::move(inv);
1236 }
1237 std::vector<unsigned char> map(256);
1238 for (int k = 0; k < 256; ++k) map[k] = static_cast<unsigned char>(k);
1239 if (!delete_mode && !s2.empty()) {
1240 // Map each byte in s1 (or in complement) to the corresponding
1241 // byte in s2; pad s2 with its last char.
1242 if (complement) {
1243 unsigned char repl = static_cast<unsigned char>(s2.back());
1244 for (int k = 0; k < 256; ++k) if (in_s1[k]) map[k] = repl;
1245 }
1246 else {
1247 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < s1.size(); ++k) {
1248 unsigned char src = static_cast<unsigned char>(s1[k]);
1249 unsigned char dst = (k < s2.size())
1250 ? static_cast<unsigned char>(s2[k])
1251 : static_cast<unsigned char>(s2.back());
1252 map[src] = dst;
1253 }
1254 }
1255 }
1256 int prev = -1;
1257 int c;
1258 while ((c = std::fgetc(stdin)) != EOF) {
1259 unsigned char uc = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
1260 if (delete_mode && in_s1[uc]) continue;
1261 unsigned char out = map[uc];
1262 if (squeeze && static_cast<int>(out) == prev) continue;
1263 std::fputc(out, stdout);
1264 prev = out;
1265 }
1266 std::fflush(stdout);
1267 return 0;
1268 }
1269
1270 // ---- cut -------------------------------------------------------------
1271
1272 struct CutSpec {
1273 std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> ranges; // [start,end], 1-indexed; -1 means "to end"
1274 bool parse(const std::string& spec) {
1275 std::size_t i = 0;
1276 while (i < spec.size()) {
1277 std::string tok;
1278 while (i < spec.size() && spec[i] != ',') tok.push_back(spec[i++]);
1279 if (i < spec.size() && spec[i] == ',') ++i;
1280 if (tok.empty()) continue;
1281 int a = 0, b = 0;
1282 auto dash = tok.find('-');
1283 try {
1284 if (dash == std::string::npos) {
1285 a = std::stoi(tok); b = a;
1286 }
1287 else if (dash == 0) {
1288 a = 1;
1289 b = std::stoi(tok.substr(1));
1290 }
1291 else if (dash + 1 == tok.size()) {
1292 a = std::stoi(tok.substr(0, dash)); b = -1;
1293 }
1294 else {
1295 a = std::stoi(tok.substr(0, dash));
1296 b = std::stoi(tok.substr(dash + 1));
1297 }
1298 }
1299 catch (...) { return false; }
1300 ranges.emplace_back(a, b);
1301 }
1302 return !ranges.empty();
1303 }
1304 bool contains(int n) const {
1305 for (auto& r : ranges) {
1306 if (n >= r.first && (r.second == -1 || n <= r.second)) return true;
1307 }
1308 return false;
1309 }
1310 };
1311
1312 static int builtin_cut(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1313 char delim = '\t';
1314 std::string field_spec, char_spec;
1315 bool only_delim_lines = false;
1316 std::vector<std::string> files;
1317 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1318 const std::string& a = args[i];
1319 if (a == "-d" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1320 if (!args[i + 1].empty()) delim = args[i + 1][0];
1321 ++i;
1322 }
1323 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-d") == 0) {
1324 delim = a[2];
1325 }
1326 else if (a == "-f" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1327 field_spec = args[++i];
1328 }
1329 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-f") == 0) {
1330 field_spec = a.substr(2);
1331 }
1332 else if (a == "-c" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1333 char_spec = args[++i];
1334 }
1335 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-c") == 0) {
1336 char_spec = a.substr(2);
1337 }
1338 else if (a == "-s") only_delim_lines = true;
1339 else if (a == "--") {
1340 for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) files.push_back(args[i]);
1341 }
1342 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') files.push_back(a);
1343 }
1344 if (field_spec.empty() && char_spec.empty()) {
1345 perr("cut", "specify -f or -c");
1346 return 1;
1347 }
1348 CutSpec spec;
1349 if (!spec.parse(field_spec.empty() ? char_spec : field_spec)) {
1350 perr("cut", "bad field/char spec");
1351 return 1;
1352 }
1353 bool by_field = !field_spec.empty();
1354 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1355 int rc = 0;
1356 for (const auto& f : files) {
1357 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1358 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) {
1359 perr("cut", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
1360 rc = 1;
1361 continue;
1362 }
1363 for (auto& line : lines) {
1364 if (by_field) {
1365 if (line.find(delim) == std::string::npos) {
1366 if (!only_delim_lines) std::printf("%s\n", line.c_str());
1367 continue;
1368 }
1369 std::vector<std::string> fields;
1370 std::string cur;
1371 for (char c : line) {
1372 if (c == delim) { fields.push_back(std::move(cur)); cur.clear(); }
1373 else cur.push_back(c);
1374 }
1375 fields.push_back(std::move(cur));
1376 std::string out;
1377 bool first = true;
1378 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < fields.size(); ++k) {
1379 if (spec.contains(static_cast<int>(k + 1))) {
1380 if (!first) out.push_back(delim);
1381 out += fields[k];
1382 first = false;
1383 }
1384 }
1385 std::printf("%s\n", out.c_str());
1386 }
1387 else {
1388 std::string out;
1389 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < line.size(); ++k) {
1390 if (spec.contains(static_cast<int>(k + 1))) out.push_back(line[k]);
1391 }
1392 std::printf("%s\n", out.c_str());
1393 }
1394 }
1395 }
1396 std::fflush(stdout);
1397 return rc;
1398 }
1399
1400 // ---- tee -------------------------------------------------------------
1401
1402 static int builtin_tee(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1403 bool append = false;
1404 std::vector<std::string> files;
1405 for (const auto& a : args) {
1406 if (a == "-a" || a == "--append") append = true;
1407 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") continue;
1408 else files.push_back(a);
1409 }
1410 std::vector<FILE*> outs;
1411 for (const auto& f : files) {
1412 FILE* fp = fopenNative(exec, f, append ? "ab" : "wb");
1413 if (!fp) {
1414 perr("tee", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
1415 }
1416 else {
1417 outs.push_back(fp);
1418 }
1419 }
1420 char buf[4096];
1421 while (true) {
1422 std::size_t got = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
1423 if (got == 0) break;
1424 std::fwrite(buf, 1, got, stdout);
1425 for (FILE* fp : outs) std::fwrite(buf, 1, got, fp);
1426 }
1427 for (FILE* fp : outs) std::fclose(fp);
1428 std::fflush(stdout);
1429 return 0;
1430 }
1431
1432 // ---- paste -----------------------------------------------------------
1433
1434 static int builtin_paste(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1435 std::string delims = "\t";
1436 std::vector<std::string> files;
1437 bool serial = false;
1438 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1439 const std::string& a = args[i];
1440 if (a == "-d" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1441 delims = args[++i];
1442 }
1443 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-d") == 0) {
1444 delims = a.substr(2);
1445 }
1446 else if (a == "-s") serial = true;
1447 else if (a == "--") { for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) files.push_back(args[i]); }
1448 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') files.push_back(a);
1449 }
1450 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1451 if (serial) {
1452 int rc = 0;
1453 for (const auto& f : files) {
1454 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1455 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) { perr("paste", f); rc = 1; continue; }
1456 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < lines.size(); ++k) {
1457 if (k) std::fputc(delims.empty() ? '\t' : delims[k % delims.size()], stdout);
1458 std::fputs(lines[k].c_str(), stdout);
1459 }
1460 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1461 }
1462 std::fflush(stdout);
1463 return rc;
1464 }
1465 std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> all;
1466 std::size_t maxlen = 0;
1467 for (const auto& f : files) {
1468 std::vector<std::string> v;
1469 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, v)) { perr("paste", f); return 1; }
1470 if (v.size() > maxlen) maxlen = v.size();
1471 all.push_back(std::move(v));
1472 }
1473 for (std::size_t r = 0; r < maxlen; ++r) {
1474 for (std::size_t c = 0; c < all.size(); ++c) {
1475 if (c) std::fputc(delims.empty() ? '\t' : delims[(c - 1) % delims.size()], stdout);
1476 if (r < all[c].size()) std::fputs(all[c][r].c_str(), stdout);
1477 }
1478 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1479 }
1480 std::fflush(stdout);
1481 return 0;
1482 }
1483
1484 // ---- tac / rev / nl --------------------------------------------------
1485
1486 static int builtin_tac(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1487 std::vector<std::string> files;
1488 for (const auto& a : args) if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') files.push_back(a);
1489 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1490 int rc = 0;
1491 for (const auto& f : files) {
1492 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1493 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) { perr("tac", f); rc = 1; continue; }
1494 for (auto it = lines.rbegin(); it != lines.rend(); ++it) {
1495 std::fputs(it->c_str(), stdout);
1496 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1497 }
1498 }
1499 std::fflush(stdout);
1500 return rc;
1501 }
1502
1503 static int builtin_rev(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1504 std::vector<std::string> files;
1505 for (const auto& a : args) if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') files.push_back(a);
1506 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1507 int rc = 0;
1508 for (const auto& f : files) {
1509 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1510 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) { perr("rev", f); rc = 1; continue; }
1511 for (auto& l : lines) {
1512 std::reverse(l.begin(), l.end());
1513 std::fputs(l.c_str(), stdout);
1514 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1515 }
1516 }
1517 std::fflush(stdout);
1518 return rc;
1519 }

1521 static int builtin_nl(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1522 bool number_blank = false;
1523 std::vector<std::string> files;
1524 for (const auto& a : args) {
1525 if (a == "-ba") number_blank = true;
1526 else if (a == "-bt") number_blank = false;
1527 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') files.push_back(a);
1528 }
1529 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
1530 int rc = 0;
1531 int n = 0;
1532 for (const auto& f : files) {
1533 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1534 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) { perr("nl", f); rc = 1; continue; }
1535 for (auto& l : lines) {
1536 if (l.empty() && !number_blank) {
1537 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1538 }
1539 else {
1540 ++n;
1541 std::fprintf(stdout, "%6d\t%s\n", n, l.c_str());
1542 }
1543 }
1544 }
1545 std::fflush(stdout);
1546 return rc;
1547 }
