1549 // ---- date / seq ------------------------------------------------------
1550
1551 static int builtin_date(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1552 std::string fmt = "%a %b %e %H:%M:%S %Y";
1553 bool utc = false;
1554 for (const auto& a : args) {
1555 if (a == "-u" || a == "--utc") utc = true;
1556 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '+') fmt = a.substr(1);
1557 }
1558 std::time_t t = std::time(nullptr);
1559 std::tm tm{};
1560#ifdef _WIN32
1561 if (utc) gmtime_s(&tm, &t); else localtime_s(&tm, &t);
1562#else
1563 if (utc) gmtime_r(&t, &tm); else localtime_r(&t, &tm);
1564#endif
1565 char buf[256];
1566 std::strftime(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt.c_str(), &tm);
1567 std::printf("%s\n", buf);
1568 return 0;
1569 }
1570
1571 static int builtin_seq(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1572 double first = 1.0, inc = 1.0, last = 1.0;
1573 std::string sep = "\n";
1574 std::vector<std::string> nums;
1575 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1576 const std::string& a = args[i];
1577 if (a == "-s" && i + 1 < args.size()) sep = args[++i];
1578 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-s") == 0) sep = a.substr(2);
1579 else if (a == "--") {
1580 for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) nums.push_back(args[i]);
1581 }
1582 else nums.push_back(a);
1583 }
1584 try {
1585 if (nums.size() == 1) { last = std::stod(nums[0]); }
1586 else if (nums.size() == 2) { first = std::stod(nums[0]); last = std::stod(nums[1]); }
1587 else if (nums.size() == 3) { first = std::stod(nums[0]); inc = std::stod(nums[1]); last = std::stod(nums[2]); }
1588 else { perr("seq", "usage: seq [LAST | FIRST LAST | FIRST INC LAST]"); return 1; }
1589 }
1590 catch (...) { perr("seq", "invalid number"); return 1; }
1591 if (inc == 0) { perr("seq", "increment must be non-zero"); return 1; }
1592 bool integer = std::floor(first) == first && std::floor(inc) == inc && std::floor(last) == last;
1593 bool first_out = true;
1594 auto emit = [&](double v) {
1595 if (!first_out) std::fputs(sep.c_str(), stdout);
1596 if (integer) std::fprintf(stdout, "%lld", static_cast<long long>(v));
1597 else std::fprintf(stdout, "%g", v);
1598 first_out = false;
1599 };
1600 if (inc > 0) {
1601 for (double v = first; v <= last + 1e-12; v += inc) emit(v);
1602 }
1603 else {
1604 for (double v = first; v >= last - 1e-12; v += inc) emit(v);
1605 }
1606 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
1607 std::fflush(stdout);
1608 return 0;
1609 }
1610
1611 // ---- uname / id ------------------------------------------------------
1612
1613 static int builtin_uname(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1614 bool s = false, n = false, r = false, v = false, m = false, o = false, all = false;
1615 for (const auto& a : args) {
1616 if (a == "-a" || a == "--all") all = true;
1617 else if (a == "-s" || a == "--kernel-name") s = true;
1618 else if (a == "-n" || a == "--nodename") n = true;
1619 else if (a == "-r" || a == "--kernel-release") r = true;
1620 else if (a == "-v" || a == "--kernel-version") v = true;
1621 else if (a == "-m" || a == "--machine") m = true;
1622 else if (a == "-o" || a == "--operating-system") o = true;
1623 else if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
1624 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
1625 switch (a[k]) {
1626 case 'a': all = true; break;
1627 case 's': s = true; break;
1628 case 'n': n = true; break;
1629 case 'r': r = true; break;
1630 case 'v': v = true; break;
1631 case 'm': m = true; break;
1632 case 'o': o = true; break;
1633 }
1634 }
1635 }
1636 }
1637 if (!all && !s && !n && !r && !v && !m && !o) s = true;
1638 if (all) s = n = r = v = m = o = true;
1639
1640 std::string node = exec.env().get("COMPUTERNAME");
1641 if (node.empty()) node = exec.env().get("HOSTNAME");
1642#ifdef _WIN32
1643 std::string arch = exec.env().get("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE");
1644 if (arch.empty()) arch = "x86_64";
1645 OSVERSIONINFOA vi{};
1646 vi.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof(vi);
1647# pragma warning(push)
1648# pragma warning(disable : 4996)
1649 GetVersionExA(&vi);
1650# pragma warning(pop)
1651 std::string release = std::to_string(vi.dwMajorVersion) + "."
1652 + std::to_string(vi.dwMinorVersion);
1653 std::string version = std::to_string(vi.dwBuildNumber);
1654#else
1655 std::string arch = "x86_64", release = "0", version = "0";
1656#endif
1657 std::string kernel = "wbsh";
1658 std::string opsys = "Windows";
1659
1660 std::string out;
1661 auto add = [&](const std::string& x) { if (!out.empty()) out += " "; out += x; };
1662 if (s) add(kernel);
1663 if (n) add(node);
1664 if (r) add(release);
1665 if (v) add(version);
1666 if (m) add(arch);
1667 if (o) add(opsys);
1668 std::printf("%s\n", out.c_str());
1669 return 0;
1670 }
1671
1672 static int builtin_id(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1673 bool name_only = false, user_only = false, group_only = false;
1674 for (const auto& a : args) {
1675 if (a == "-n") name_only = true;
1676 else if (a == "-u") user_only = true;
1677 else if (a == "-g") group_only = true;
1678 }
1679 std::string user = exec.env().get("USER");
1680 if (user.empty()) user = exec.env().get("USERNAME");
1681 if (user.empty()) user = "user";
1682 // Windows lacks POSIX uid/gid; print stable placeholders.
1683 int uid = 1000, gid = 1000;
1684 if (user_only) {
1685 if (name_only) std::printf("%s\n", user.c_str());
1686 else std::printf("%d\n", uid);
1687 }
1688 else if (group_only) {
1689 if (name_only) std::printf("%s\n", user.c_str());
1690 else std::printf("%d\n", gid);
1691 }
1692 else {
1693 std::printf("uid=%d(%s) gid=%d(%s) groups=%d(%s)\n",
1694 uid, user.c_str(), gid, user.c_str(), gid, user.c_str());
1695 }
1696 return 0;
1697 }
1698
1699 // ---- realpath / readlink --------------------------------------------
1700
1701 static int builtin_realpath(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1702 if (args.empty()) { perr("realpath", "missing operand"); return 1; }
1703 int rc = 0;
1704 for (const auto& p : args) {
1705 if (!p.empty() && p[0] == '-') continue;
1706 std::error_code ec;
1707 fs::path nat = fs::weakly_canonical(toNative(exec, p), ec);
1708 if (ec) { perr("realpath", p, ec); rc = 1; continue; }
1709 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(nat)).c_str());
1710 }
1711 return rc;
1712 }
1713
1714 static int builtin_readlink(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1715 bool canonical = false;
1716 std::vector<std::string> paths;
1717 for (const auto& a : args) {
1718 if (a == "-f" || a == "-e" || a == "-m" || a == "--canonicalize") canonical = true;
1719 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') paths.push_back(a);
1720 }
1721 if (paths.empty()) { perr("readlink", "missing operand"); return 1; }
1722 int rc = 0;
1723 for (const auto& p : paths) {
1724 std::error_code ec;
1725 if (canonical) {
1726 fs::path q = fs::weakly_canonical(toNative(exec, p), ec);
1727 if (ec) { rc = 1; continue; }
1728 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(q)).c_str());
1729 }
1730 else {
1731 fs::path q = fs::read_symlink(toNative(exec, p), ec);
1732 if (ec) { rc = 1; continue; }
1733 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(q)).c_str());
1734 }
1735 }
1736 return rc;
1737 }
1738
1739 // ---- expr (simple) ---------------------------------------------------
1740
1741 static int builtin_expr(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1742 // Tiny `expr`: integer arithmetic + string `length`, `substr`, `index`.
1743 // Not full POSIX, but handles common scripts.
1744 if (args.empty()) { perr("expr", "missing operand"); return 2; }
1745 if (args.size() == 2 && args[0] == "length") {
1746 std::printf("%zu\n", args[1].size());
1747 return 0;
1748 }
1749 if (args.size() == 4 && args[0] == "substr") {
1750 try {
1751 int p = std::stoi(args[2]);
1752 int n = std::stoi(args[3]);
1753 if (p < 1) p = 1;
1754 std::size_t start = static_cast<std::size_t>(p - 1);
1755 if (start >= args[1].size()) { std::printf("\n"); return 1; }
1756 std::printf("%s\n", args[1].substr(start, n).c_str());
1757 return 0;
1758 }
1759 catch (...) { return 2; }
1760 }
1761 if (args.size() == 3) {
1762 const std::string& l = args[0]; const std::string& op = args[1]; const std::string& r = args[2];
1763 try {
1764 long long li = std::stoll(l), ri = std::stoll(r);
1765 if (op == "+") { std::printf("%lld\n", li + ri); return 0; }
1766 if (op == "-") { std::printf("%lld\n", li - ri); return 0; }
1767 if (op == "*") { std::printf("%lld\n", li * ri); return 0; }
1768 if (op == "/") { if (ri == 0) return 2; std::printf("%lld\n", li / ri); return 0; }
1769 if (op == "%") { if (ri == 0) return 2; std::printf("%lld\n", li % ri); return 0; }
1770 if (op == "<") { std::printf("%d\n", li < ri); return (li < ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1771 if (op == "<=") { std::printf("%d\n", li <= ri); return (li <= ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1772 if (op == ">") { std::printf("%d\n", li > ri); return (li > ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1773 if (op == ">=") { std::printf("%d\n", li >= ri); return (li >= ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1774 if (op == "=" || op == "==") { std::printf("%d\n", li == ri); return (li == ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1775 if (op == "!=") { std::printf("%d\n", li != ri); return (li != ri) ? 0 : 1; }
1776 }
1777 catch (...) {
1778 if (op == "=" || op == "==") { std::printf("%d\n", l == r); return (l == r) ? 0 : 1; }
1779 if (op == "!=") { std::printf("%d\n", l != r); return (l != r) ? 0 : 1; }
1780 }
1781 }
1782 // Fallback: print joined with spaces.
1783 std::string out;
1784 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1785 if (i) out.push_back(' ');
1786 out += args[i];
1787 }
1788 std::printf("%s\n", out.c_str());
1789 return 0;
1790 }
1791
1792 // ---- grep ------------------------------------------------------------
1793
1794 static int builtin_grep(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1795 bool icase = false, invert = false, line_no = false, count_only = false;
1796 bool fixed = false, list_only = false, quiet = false, recursive = false;
1797 std::string pattern;
1798 std::vector<std::string> files;
1799 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1800 const std::string& a = args[i];
1801 if (a == "--") {
1802 for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) {
1803 if (pattern.empty()) pattern = args[i];
1804 else files.push_back(args[i]);
1805 } break;
1806 }
1807 if (a == "-e" && i + 1 < args.size()) { pattern = args[++i]; continue; }
1808 if (a == "-i" || a == "--ignore-case") { icase = true; continue; }
1809 if (a == "-v" || a == "--invert-match") { invert = true; continue; }
1810 if (a == "-n" || a == "--line-number") { line_no = true; continue; }
1811 if (a == "-c" || a == "--count") { count_only = true; continue; }
1812 if (a == "-F" || a == "--fixed-strings") { fixed = true; continue; }
1813 if (a == "-E" || a == "--extended-regexp") { continue; }
1814 if (a == "-l") { list_only = true; continue; }
1815 if (a == "-q" || a == "--quiet" || a == "--silent") { quiet = true; continue; }
1816 if (a == "-r" || a == "-R" || a == "--recursive") { recursive = true; continue; }
1817 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
1818 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
1819 switch (a[k]) {
1820 case 'i': icase = true; break;
1821 case 'v': invert = true; break;
1822 case 'n': line_no = true; break;
1823 case 'c': count_only = true; break;
1824 case 'F': fixed = true; break;
1825 case 'E': break;
1826 case 'l': list_only = true; break;
1827 case 'q': quiet = true; break;
1828 case 'r': case 'R': recursive = true; break;
1829 default:
1830 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: grep: unknown option -%c\n", a[k]);
1831 return 2;
1832 }
1833 }
1834 continue;
1835 }
1836 if (pattern.empty()) pattern = a;
1837 else files.push_back(a);
1838 }
1839 if (pattern.empty()) { perr("grep", "missing pattern"); return 2; }
1840 if (files.empty()) files.push_back(recursive ? "." : "-");
1841
1842 // -r: expand any directory arg into the files it contains.
1843 if (recursive) {
1844 std::vector<std::string> expanded;
1845 for (const auto& f : files) {
1846 if (f == "-") { expanded.push_back(f); continue; }
1847 fs::path nat = toNative(exec, f);
1848 std::error_code ec;
1849 if (!fs::is_directory(nat, ec)) {
1850 expanded.push_back(f);
1851 continue;
1852 }
1853 fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(nat,
1854 fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
1855 if (ec) continue;
1856 for (auto cur = it; cur != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); cur.increment(ec)) {
1857 if (ec) break;
1858 std::error_code fec;
1859 if (cur->is_regular_file(fec)) {
1860 std::string p = pathToUtf8(cur->path());
1861 std::replace(p.begin(), p.end(), '\\', '/');
1862 expanded.push_back(p);
1863 }
1864 }
1865 }
1866 files = std::move(expanded);
1867 }
1868
1869 std::regex::flag_type flags = std::regex::ECMAScript;
1870 if (icase) flags |= std::regex::icase;
1871 std::regex re;
1872 if (!fixed) {
1873 try { re = std::regex(pattern, flags); }
1874 catch (const std::regex_error& e) {
1875 perr("grep", std::string("bad pattern: ") + e.what());
1876 return 2;
1877 }
1878 }
1879 std::string lower_pat;
1880 if (fixed && icase) {
1881 lower_pat = pattern;
1882 for (char& c : lower_pat) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c));
1883 }
1884
1885 auto match_line = [&](const std::string& line) {
1886 if (fixed) {
1887 if (!icase) return line.find(pattern) != std::string::npos;
1888 std::string lo = line;
1889 for (char& c : lo) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower((unsigned char)c));
1890 return lo.find(lower_pat) != std::string::npos;
1891 }
1892 return std::regex_search(line, re);
1893 };
1894
1895 bool any_match = false;
1896 bool show_filename = files.size() > 1;
1897 int rc = 1; // default: no matches
1898 for (const auto& f : files) {
1899 std::vector<std::string> lines;
1900 if (!readAllLines(exec, f, lines)) {
1901 perr("grep", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
1902 rc = 2;
1903 continue;
1904 }
1905 int file_count = 0;
1906 bool file_any = false;
1907 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < lines.size(); ++k) {
1908 bool m = match_line(lines[k]);
1909 if (invert) m = !m;
1910 if (!m) continue;
1911 ++file_count;
1912 file_any = true;
1913 any_match = true;
1914 if (quiet) goto next_file;
1915 if (list_only) { std::printf("%s\n", f.c_str()); break; }
1916 if (count_only) continue;
1917 if (show_filename) std::printf("%s:", f.c_str());
1918 if (line_no) std::printf("%zu:", k + 1);
1919 std::printf("%s\n", lines[k].c_str());
1920 }
1921 if (count_only && !list_only && !quiet) {
1922 if (show_filename) std::printf("%s:", f.c_str());
1923 std::printf("%d\n", file_count);
1924 }
1925 next_file:
1926 (void)file_any;
1927 }
1928 std::fflush(stdout);
1929 if (quiet) return any_match ? 0 : 1;
1930 return any_match ? 0 : rc;
1931 }
1932
1933 // ---- find ------------------------------------------------------------
1934
1935 static int builtin_find(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
1936 std::vector<std::string> roots;
1937 std::string name_pat;
1938 char type_filter = 0; // 0 = any, 'f' = file, 'd' = dir, 'l' = symlink
1939 int max_depth = -1;
1940 std::size_t i = 0;
1941 while (i < args.size()) {
1942 const std::string& a = args[i];
1943 if (a == "-name" && i + 1 < args.size()) { name_pat = args[++i]; ++i; continue; }
1944 if (a == "-type" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1945 if (!args[i + 1].empty()) type_filter = args[i + 1][0];
1946 i += 2; continue;
1947 }
1948 if (a == "-maxdepth" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
1949 try { max_depth = std::stoi(args[++i]); ++i; continue; }
1950 catch (...) { perr("find", "bad -maxdepth"); return 1; }
1951 }
1952 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') {
1953 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: find: option %s not implemented\n", a.c_str());
1954 return 1;
1955 }
1956 roots.push_back(a);
1957 ++i;
1958 }
1959 if (roots.empty()) roots.push_back(".");
1960
1961 auto match_name = [&](const std::string& name) {
1962 if (name_pat.empty()) return true;
1963 // Lightweight glob: treat * and ? like fnmatch.
1964 std::regex_constants::syntax_option_type fl = std::regex::ECMAScript;
1965 std::string r;
1966 for (char c : name_pat) {
1967 switch (c) {
1968 case '*': r += ".*"; break;
1969 case '?': r += "."; break;
1970 case '.': case '+': case '(': case ')': case '|': case '^':
1971 case '$': case '{': case '}': case '\\':
1972 r.push_back('\\'); r.push_back(c); break;
1973 default: r.push_back(c); break;
1974 }
1975 }
1976 try { return std::regex_match(name, std::regex(r, fl)); }
1977 catch (...) { return false; }
1978 };
1979
1980 auto pass_type = [&](const fs::path& p) {
1981 std::error_code ec;
1982 if (type_filter == 0) return true;
1983 auto st = fs::symlink_status(p, ec);
1984 if (ec) return false;
1985 if (type_filter == 'l') return fs::is_symlink(st);
1986 if (type_filter == 'd') return fs::is_directory(st);
1987 if (type_filter == 'f') return fs::is_regular_file(st);
1988 return true;
1989 };
1990
1991 int rc = 0;
1992 for (const auto& r : roots) {
1993 std::error_code ec;
1994 fs::path nat(toNative(exec, r));
1995 if (!fs::exists(nat, ec)) {
1996 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: find: %s: no such file or directory\n", r.c_str());
1997 rc = 1;
1998 continue;
1999 }
2000 // Print root itself if it matches.
2001 if (pass_type(nat) && match_name(pathToUtf8(nat.filename()).empty() ? r : pathToUtf8(nat.filename()))) {
2002 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(nat)).c_str());
2003 }
2004 if (!fs::is_directory(nat, ec)) continue;
2005 fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(nat,
2006 fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
2007 if (ec) continue;
2008 for (auto cur = it; cur != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); cur.increment(ec)) {
2009 if (ec) break;
2010 if (max_depth >= 0 && cur.depth() >= max_depth) cur.disable_recursion_pending();
2011 fs::path p = cur->path();
2012 if (!pass_type(p)) continue;
2013 if (!match_name(pathToUtf8(p.filename()))) continue;
2014 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(p)).c_str());
2015 }
2016 }
2017 std::fflush(stdout);
2018 return rc;
2019 }
2020
2021 // ---- tar (ustar, uncompressed) -------------------------------------
2022
2023 struct TarHeader {
2024 char name[100];
2025 char mode[8];
2026 char uid[8];
2027 char gid[8];
2028 char size[12];
2029 char mtime[12];
2030 char chksum[8];
2031 char typeflag;
2032 char linkname[100];
2033 char magic[6]; // "ustar\0"
2034 char version[2]; // "00"
2035 char uname[32];
2036 char gname[32];
2037 char devmajor[8];
2038 char devminor[8];
2039 char prefix[155];
2040 char pad[12];
2041 };
2042 static_assert(sizeof(TarHeader) == 512, "tar header must be 512 bytes");
2043
2044 static void tarOctal(char* dst, std::size_t width, std::uintmax_t v) {
2045 std::string s;
2046 while (v > 0) { s.insert(s.begin(), char('0' + (v & 7))); v >>= 3; }
2047 if (s.empty()) s = "0";
2048 while (s.size() < width - 1) s.insert(s.begin(), '0');
2049 std::memset(dst, 0, width);
2050 std::memcpy(dst, s.data(), (std::min)(s.size(), width - 1));
2051 }
2052
2053 std::uintmax_t tarParseOctal(const char* p, std::size_t n) {
2054 std::uintmax_t v = 0;
2055 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n && p[i] && p[i] != ' '; ++i) {
2056 if (p[i] < '0' || p[i] > '7') break;
2057 v = (v << 3) | (p[i] - '0');
2058 }
2059 return v;
2060 }
2061
2062 static void tarFillChecksum(TarHeader* h) {
2063 std::memset(h->chksum, ' ', sizeof(h->chksum));
2064 std::uintmax_t s = 0;
2065 const unsigned char* p = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(h);
2066 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(*h); ++i) s += p[i];
2067 tarOctal(h->chksum, 7, s);
2068 h->chksum[6] = '\0';
2069 h->chksum[7] = ' ';
2070 }
2071
2072 static bool tarWriteEntry(FILE* out, const fs::path& src, const std::string& rel,
2073 bool verbose) {
2074 std::error_code ec;
2075 fs::file_status st = fs::symlink_status(src, ec);
2076 if (ec) return false;
2077 TarHeader h{};
2078 std::string name = rel;
2079 std::replace(name.begin(), name.end(), '\\', '/');
2080 if (fs::is_directory(st)) {
2081 if (!name.empty() && name.back() != '/') name.push_back('/');
2082 h.typeflag = '5';
2083 }
2084 else {
2085 h.typeflag = '0';
2086 }
2087 if (name.size() >= sizeof(h.name)) {
2088 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: tar: name too long: %s\n", name.c_str());
2089 return false;
2090 }
2091 std::strncpy(h.name, name.c_str(), sizeof(h.name) - 1);
2092 tarOctal(h.mode, 8, 0644);
2093 tarOctal(h.uid, 8, 0);
2094 tarOctal(h.gid, 8, 0);
2095 std::uintmax_t size = (h.typeflag == '5') ? 0 : fs::file_size(src, ec);
2096 if (ec) size = 0;
2097 tarOctal(h.size, 12, size);
2098 std::time_t mt = 0;
2099 {
2100 auto t = fs::last_write_time(src, ec);
2101 if (!ec) {
2102 mt = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(
2103 std::chrono::system_clock::now()
2104 + std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::system_clock::duration>(
2105 t - fs::file_time_type::clock::now()));
2106 }
2107 }
2108 tarOctal(h.mtime, 12, static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(mt));
2109 std::memcpy(h.magic, "ustar\0", 6);
2110 std::memcpy(h.version, "00", 2);
2111 tarFillChecksum(&h);
2112 std::fwrite(&h, 1, sizeof(h), out);
2113 if (verbose) std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", name.c_str());
2114 if (h.typeflag != '5' && size > 0) {
2115 FILE* in = openUtf8(pathToUtf8(src), "rb");
2116 if (!in) return false;
2117 char buf[512];
2118 std::uintmax_t left = size;
2119 while (left > 0) {
2120 std::size_t want = (std::min)(static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(512), left);
2121 std::size_t got = std::fread(buf, 1, want, in);
2122 if (got == 0) break;
2123 std::fwrite(buf, 1, got, out);
2124 if (got < 512) {
2125 char zero[512] = {};
2126 std::fwrite(zero, 1, 512 - got, out);
2127 }
2128 left -= got;
2129 }
2130 std::fclose(in);
2131 }
2132 return true;
2133 }
2134
2135 static int tarCreate(Executor& exec, const std::string& archive,
2136 const std::vector<std::string>& items, bool verbose) {
2137 FILE* out = fopenNative(exec, archive, "wb");
2138 if (!out) { perr("tar", archive + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); return 1; }
2139 int rc = 0;
2140 for (const auto& item : items) {
2141 fs::path nat(toNative(exec, item));
2142 std::error_code ec;
2143 if (!fs::exists(nat, ec)) {
2144 perr("tar", item + ": not found");
2145 rc = 1;
2146 continue;
2147 }
2148 if (fs::is_directory(nat, ec)) {
2149 tarWriteEntry(out, nat, item, verbose);
2150 fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(nat,
2151 fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
2152 if (ec) continue;
2153 for (auto cur = it; cur != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); cur.increment(ec)) {
2154 if (ec) break;
2155 std::error_code rec;
2156 std::string rel = item + "/" + pathToUtf8(fs::relative(cur->path(), nat, rec));
2157 tarWriteEntry(out, cur->path(), rel, verbose);
2158 }
2159 }
2160 else {
2161 tarWriteEntry(out, nat, item, verbose);
2162 }
2163 }
2164 char zero[1024] = {};
2165 std::fwrite(zero, 1, 1024, out);
2166 std::fclose(out);
2167 return rc;
2168 }
2169
2170 static int tarExtract(Executor& exec, const std::string& archive, bool verbose, bool list_only) {
2171 FILE* in = fopenNative(exec, archive, "rb");
2172 if (!in) { perr("tar", archive + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); return 1; }
2173 int rc = 0;
2174 while (true) {
2175 TarHeader h{};
2176 std::size_t got = std::fread(&h, 1, sizeof(h), in);
2177 if (got != sizeof(h)) break;
2178 bool all_zero = true;
2179 const unsigned char* p = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&h);
2180 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < sizeof(h); ++k) {
2181 if (p[k]) { all_zero = false; break; }
2182 }
2183 if (all_zero) break;
2184 std::string name(h.name, ::strnlen(h.name, sizeof(h.name)));
2185 std::uintmax_t size = tarParseOctal(h.size, sizeof(h.size));
2186 bool is_dir = (h.typeflag == '5')
2187 || (!name.empty() && name.back() == '/');
2188 if (verbose || list_only) std::printf("%s\n", name.c_str());
2189 if (list_only) {
2190 std::uintmax_t skip = (size + 511) & ~static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(511);
2191 std::fseek(in, static_cast<long>(skip), SEEK_CUR);
2192 continue;
2193 }
2194 if (is_dir) {
2195 std::error_code ec;
2196 fs::create_directories(toNative(exec, name), ec);
2197 std::uintmax_t skip = (size + 511) & ~static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(511);
2198 std::fseek(in, static_cast<long>(skip), SEEK_CUR);
2199 continue;
2200 }
2201 // Ensure parent dir.
2202 {
2203 fs::path p(toNative(exec, name));
2204 std::error_code ec;
2205 fs::create_directories(p.parent_path(), ec);
2206 }
2207 FILE* out = fopenNative(exec, name, "wb");
2208 if (!out) {
2209 perr("tar", name + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
2210 rc = 1;
2211 std::uintmax_t skip = (size + 511) & ~static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(511);
2212 std::fseek(in, static_cast<long>(skip), SEEK_CUR);
2213 continue;
2214 }
2215 char buf[512];
2216 std::uintmax_t left = size;
2217 while (left > 0) {
2218 std::size_t want = 512;
2219 std::size_t r = std::fread(buf, 1, want, in);
2220 if (r == 0) break;
2221 std::size_t writeN = (left >= 512) ? 512 : static_cast<std::size_t>(left);
2222 std::fwrite(buf, 1, writeN, out);
2223 left -= writeN;
2224 }
2225 std::fclose(out);
2226 }
2227 std::fclose(in);
2228 return rc;
2229 }
2230
2231 static int builtin_tar(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2232 char mode = 0;
2233 bool verbose = false;
2234 std::string archive;
2235 std::vector<std::string> items;
2236 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
2237 const std::string& a = args[i];
2238 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a.size() > 1) {
2239 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
2240 char c = a[k];
2241 if (c == 'c' || c == 'x' || c == 't') mode = c;
2242 else if (c == 'v') verbose = true;
2243 else if (c == 'f') {
2244 if (k + 1 < a.size()) archive = a.substr(k + 1);
2245 else if (i + 1 < args.size()) archive = args[++i];
2246 k = a.size();
2247 }
2248 }
2249 continue;
2250 }
2251 items.push_back(a);
2252 }
2253 if (mode == 0) { perr("tar", "specify -c, -x, or -t"); return 2; }
2254 if (archive.empty()) { perr("tar", "missing -f ARCHIVE"); return 2; }
2255 switch (mode) {
2256 case 'c': return tarCreate(exec, archive, items, verbose);
2257 case 'x': return tarExtract(exec, archive, verbose, false);
2258 case 't': return tarExtract(exec, archive, false, true);
2259 }
2260 return 2;
2261 }
2262
2263 // ---- curl (basic HTTP/HTTPS GET via WinHTTP) -----------------------
2264
2265#ifdef _WIN32
2266 std::wstring utf8ToWideLocal(const std::string& s) {
2267 if (s.empty()) return {};
2268 int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), (int)s.size(), nullptr, 0);
2269 std::wstring r(n, L'\0');
2270 MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), (int)s.size(), r.data(), n);
2271 return r;
2272 }
2273#endif
2274
2275 static int builtin_curl(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2276#ifndef _WIN32
2277 (void)exec; (void)args;
2278 perr("curl", "not supported");
2279 return 1;
2280#else
2281 bool silent = false;
2282 bool include_headers = false;
2283 bool head_only = false;
2284 bool save_remote = false;
2285 std::string output_file;
2286 std::string method = "GET";
2287 std::string body_data;
2288 std::vector<std::string> headers;
2289 std::string url;
2290
2291 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
2292 const std::string& a = args[i];
2293 // Long forms.
2294 if (a == "--silent") { silent = true; continue; }
2295 if (a == "--include") { include_headers = true; continue; }
2296 if (a == "--head") { head_only = true; method = "HEAD"; continue; }
2297 if (a == "--location") continue;
2298 if (a == "--remote-name") { save_remote = true; continue; }
2299 if (a == "--output" && i + 1 < args.size()) { output_file = args[++i]; continue; }
2300 if (a == "--request" && i + 1 < args.size()) { method = args[++i]; continue; }
2301 if (a == "--header" && i + 1 < args.size()) { headers.push_back(args[++i]); continue; }
2302 if (a == "--data" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2303 body_data = args[++i];
2304 if (method == "GET") method = "POST";
2305 continue;
2306 }
2307 // Short flags, possibly bundled. The value-taking ones (-o/-X/-H/-d)
2308 // must be the last char in the cluster.
2309 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && a[1] != '-') {
2310 bool consumed_next = false;
2311 for (std::size_t k = 1; k < a.size(); ++k) {
2312 char c = a[k];
2313 bool last = (k + 1 == a.size());
2314 switch (c) {
2315 case 's': silent = true; break;
2316 case 'i': include_headers = true; break;
2317 case 'I': head_only = true; method = "HEAD"; break;
2318 case 'L': break;
2319 case 'O': save_remote = true; break;
2320 case 'o':
2321 if (last && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2322 output_file = args[++i];
2323 consumed_next = true;
2324 }
2325 break;
2326 case 'X':
2327 if (last && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2328 method = args[++i];
2329 consumed_next = true;
2330 }
2331 break;
2332 case 'H':
2333 if (last && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2334 headers.push_back(args[++i]);
2335 consumed_next = true;
2336 }
2337 break;
2338 case 'd':
2339 if (last && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2340 body_data = args[++i];
2341 if (method == "GET") method = "POST";
2342 consumed_next = true;
2343 }
2344 break;
2345 default: break;
2346 }
2347 }
2348 (void)consumed_next;
2349 continue;
2350 }
2351 if (!a.empty() && a[0] != '-') url = a;
2352 }
2353
2354 if (url.empty()) {
2355 if (!silent) perr("curl", "no URL specified");
2356 return 2;
2357 }
2358
2359 // Default to https:// if no scheme.
2360 if (url.find("://") == std::string::npos) url = "https://" + url;
2361
2362 URL_COMPONENTS uc{};
2363 uc.dwStructSize = sizeof(uc);
2364 wchar_t hostBuf[256] = {};
2365 wchar_t pathBuf[2048] = {};
2366 uc.lpszHostName = hostBuf;
2367 uc.dwHostNameLength = sizeof(hostBuf) / sizeof(hostBuf[0]);
2368 uc.lpszUrlPath = pathBuf;
2369 uc.dwUrlPathLength = sizeof(pathBuf) / sizeof(pathBuf[0]);
2370
2371 std::wstring wurl = utf8ToWideLocal(url);
2372 if (!WinHttpCrackUrl(wurl.c_str(), 0, 0, &uc)) {
2373 if (!silent) perr("curl", "bad URL");
2374 return 1;
2375 }
2376 bool is_https = (uc.nScheme == INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTPS);
2377 std::wstring path = uc.dwUrlPathLength
2378 ? std::wstring(uc.lpszUrlPath, uc.dwUrlPathLength)
2379 : std::wstring(L"/");
2380
2381 HINTERNET hSession = WinHttpOpen(L"wbsh-curl/0.1",
2382 WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_DEFAULT_PROXY,
2383 WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0);
2384 if (!hSession) { if (!silent) perr("curl", "WinHttpOpen failed"); return 1; }
2385
2386 HINTERNET hConnect = WinHttpConnect(hSession, hostBuf, uc.nPort, 0);
2387 if (!hConnect) {
2388 WinHttpCloseHandle(hSession);
2389 if (!silent) perr("curl", "connect failed");
2390 return 1;
2391 }
2392
2393 std::wstring wmethod = utf8ToWideLocal(method);
2394 HINTERNET hRequest = WinHttpOpenRequest(hConnect, wmethod.c_str(),
2395 path.c_str(), nullptr, WINHTTP_NO_REFERER,
2396 WINHTTP_DEFAULT_ACCEPT_TYPES,
2397 is_https ? WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE : 0);
2398 if (!hRequest) {
2399 WinHttpCloseHandle(hConnect);
2400 WinHttpCloseHandle(hSession);
2401 if (!silent) perr("curl", "open request failed");
2402 return 1;
2403 }
2404
2405 // Add custom headers.
2406 for (const auto& h : headers) {
2407 std::wstring wh = utf8ToWideLocal(h + "\r\n");
2408 WinHttpAddRequestHeaders(hRequest, wh.c_str(),
2409 (DWORD)-1L, WINHTTP_ADDREQ_FLAG_ADD);
2410 }
2411
2412 BOOL r = WinHttpSendRequest(hRequest,
2413 WINHTTP_NO_ADDITIONAL_HEADERS, 0,
2414 body_data.empty() ? WINHTTP_NO_REQUEST_DATA
2415 : const_cast<char*>(body_data.data()),
2416 static_cast<DWORD>(body_data.size()),
2417 static_cast<DWORD>(body_data.size()), 0);
2418 if (!r || !WinHttpReceiveResponse(hRequest, nullptr)) {
2419 DWORD err = GetLastError();
2420 WinHttpCloseHandle(hRequest);
2421 WinHttpCloseHandle(hConnect);
2422 WinHttpCloseHandle(hSession);
2423 if (!silent) std::fprintf(stderr,
2424 "wbsh: curl: request failed (err=%lu)\n", err);
2425 return 1;
2426 }
2427
2428 DWORD status_code = 0;
2429 DWORD sz = sizeof(status_code);
2430 WinHttpQueryHeaders(hRequest,
2431 WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER,
2432 WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX,
2433 &status_code, &sz, WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX);
2434
2435 // Decide where to write. If -O, derive from URL path.
2436 FILE* out = stdout;
2437 std::string opened_path;
2438 if (save_remote) {
2439 std::string p(path.begin(), path.end());
2440 auto slash = p.find_last_of('/');
2441 std::string name = (slash == std::string::npos) ? p : p.substr(slash + 1);
2442 if (name.empty() || name == "/") name = "index.html";
2443 output_file = name;
2444 }
2445 if (!output_file.empty()) {
2446 out = fopenNative(exec, output_file, "wb");
2447 if (!out) {
2448 WinHttpCloseHandle(hRequest);
2449 WinHttpCloseHandle(hConnect);
2450 WinHttpCloseHandle(hSession);
2451 if (!silent) perr("curl", output_file + ": cannot open");
2452 return 1;
2453 }
2454 opened_path = output_file;
2455 }
2456
2457 if (include_headers || head_only) {
2458 DWORD hdr_size = 0;
2459 WinHttpQueryHeaders(hRequest, WINHTTP_QUERY_RAW_HEADERS_CRLF,
2460 WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX, nullptr, &hdr_size,
2461 WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX);
2462 if (hdr_size > 0) {
2463 std::vector<wchar_t> hbuf(hdr_size / sizeof(wchar_t) + 1);
2464 if (WinHttpQueryHeaders(hRequest, WINHTTP_QUERY_RAW_HEADERS_CRLF,
2465 WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX,
2466 hbuf.data(), &hdr_size, WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX)) {
2467 int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, hbuf.data(), -1,
2468 nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
2469 std::string utf(n, '\0');
2470 WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, hbuf.data(), -1,
2471 utf.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
2472 std::fwrite(utf.data(), 1, utf.size() ? utf.size() - 1 : 0, out);
2473 }
2474 }
2475 }
2476
2477 if (!head_only) {
2478 while (true) {
2479 DWORD avail = 0;
2480 if (!WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(hRequest, &avail)) break;
2481 if (avail == 0) break;
2482 std::vector<char> buf(avail);
2483 DWORD got = 0;
2484 if (!WinHttpReadData(hRequest, buf.data(), avail, &got)) break;
2485 if (got == 0) break;
2486 std::fwrite(buf.data(), 1, got, out);
2487 }
2488 }
2489
2490 WinHttpCloseHandle(hRequest);
2491 WinHttpCloseHandle(hConnect);
2492 WinHttpCloseHandle(hSession);
2493 if (out != stdout) std::fclose(out);
2494 std::fflush(stdout);
2495 return (status_code >= 400) ? 22 : 0;
2496#endif
2497 }

2499 // ---- Hashes (md5sum / sha1sum / sha256sum / sha512sum) -------------
2500
2501#ifdef _WIN32
2502 static bool computeHashHex(LPCWSTR algId, FILE* fp, std::string& hex_out) {
2503 BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE hAlg = nullptr;
2504 if (BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&hAlg, algId, nullptr, 0) != 0) return false;
2505 DWORD hashLen = 0, dummy = 0;
2506 BCryptGetProperty(hAlg, BCRYPT_HASH_LENGTH,
2507 reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(&hashLen), sizeof(hashLen), &dummy, 0);
2508 BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE hHash = nullptr;
2509 if (BCryptCreateHash(hAlg, &hHash, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, 0) != 0) {
2510 BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hAlg, 0);
2511 return false;
2512 }
2513 unsigned char buf[8192];
2514 while (true) {
2515 std::size_t n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), fp);
2516 if (n == 0) break;
2517 BCryptHashData(hHash, buf, static_cast<ULONG>(n), 0);
2518 }
2519 std::vector<unsigned char> bytes(hashLen);
2520 BCryptFinishHash(hHash, bytes.data(), hashLen, 0);
2521 BCryptDestroyHash(hHash);
2522 BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hAlg, 0);
2523 char hex[3];
2524 hex_out.reserve(hashLen * 2);
2525 for (DWORD i = 0; i < hashLen; ++i) {
2526 std::snprintf(hex, sizeof(hex), "%02x", bytes[i]);
2527 hex_out += hex;
2528 }
2529 return true;
2530 }
2531#endif
2532
2533 static int builtinHashImpl(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args,
2534 const wchar_t* algId, const char* cmd) {
2535 std::vector<std::string> files;
2536 for (const auto& a : args) {
2537 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") continue;
2538 files.push_back(a);
2539 }
2540 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
2541 int rc = 0;
2542 for (const auto& f : files) {
2543 FILE* fp = (f == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, f, "rb");
2544 if (!fp) {
2545 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: %s: %s: %s\n",
2546 cmd, f.c_str(), std::strerror(errno));
2547 rc = 1;
2548 continue;
2549 }
2550 std::string hex;
2551#ifdef _WIN32
2552 bool ok = computeHashHex(algId, fp, hex);
2553#else
2554 bool ok = false;
2555 (void)algId;
2556#endif
2557 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
2558 if (!ok) {
2559 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: %s: hash failed\n", cmd);
2560 rc = 1;
2561 continue;
2562 }
2563 std::printf("%s %s\n", hex.c_str(), f.c_str());
2564 }
2565 std::fflush(stdout);
2566 return rc;
2567 }
2568
2569 static int builtin_md5sum(Executor& e, const std::vector<std::string>& a) {
2570 return builtinHashImpl(e, a, BCRYPT_MD5_ALGORITHM, "md5sum");
2571 }
2572 static int builtin_sha1sum(Executor& e, const std::vector<std::string>& a) {
2573 return builtinHashImpl(e, a, BCRYPT_SHA1_ALGORITHM, "sha1sum");
2574 }
2575 static int builtin_sha256sum(Executor& e, const std::vector<std::string>& a) {
2576 return builtinHashImpl(e, a, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, "sha256sum");
2577 }
2578 static int builtin_sha512sum(Executor& e, const std::vector<std::string>& a) {
2579 return builtinHashImpl(e, a, BCRYPT_SHA512_ALGORITHM, "sha512sum");
2580 }

2582 // ---- base64 ---------------------------------------------------------
2583
2584 const char* kB64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
2585
2586 static std::string base64Encode(const std::vector<unsigned char>& in) {
2587 std::string out;
2588 std::size_t n = in.size();
2589 out.reserve(((n + 2) / 3) * 4);
2590 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; i += 3) {
2591 unsigned int v = static_cast<unsigned int>(in[i]) << 16;
2592 if (i + 1 < n) v |= static_cast<unsigned int>(in[i + 1]) << 8;
2593 if (i + 2 < n) v |= static_cast<unsigned int>(in[i + 2]);
2594 out.push_back(kB64[(v >> 18) & 0x3F]);
2595 out.push_back(kB64[(v >> 12) & 0x3F]);
2596 out.push_back((i + 1 < n) ? kB64[(v >> 6) & 0x3F] : '=');
2597 out.push_back((i + 2 < n) ? kB64[v & 0x3F] : '=');
2598 }
2599 return out;
2600 }
2601
2602 static std::vector<unsigned char> base64Decode(const std::string& in, bool& ok) {
2603 ok = true;
2604 int dec[256];
2605 for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) dec[i] = -1;
2606 for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) dec[static_cast<unsigned char>(kB64[i])] = i;
2607 std::vector<unsigned char> out;
2608 int v = 0, bits = 0;
2609 for (char c : in) {
2610 if (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == ' ' || c == '\t') continue;
2611 if (c == '=') break;
2612 int d = dec[static_cast<unsigned char>(c)];
2613 if (d < 0) { ok = false; return out; }
2614 v = (v << 6) | d;
2615 bits += 6;
2616 if (bits >= 8) {
2617 bits -= 8;
2618 out.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>((v >> bits) & 0xFF));
2619 }
2620 }
2621 return out;
2622 }
2623
2624 static int builtin_base64(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2625 bool decode = false;
2626 std::string file = "-";
2627 std::size_t wrap = 76;
2628 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
2629 const std::string& a = args[i];
2630 if (a == "-d" || a == "--decode") { decode = true; continue; }
2631 if (a == "-w" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2632 try { wrap = std::stoul(args[++i]); }
2633 catch (...) {}
2634 continue;
2635 }
2636 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") continue;
2637 file = a;
2638 }
2639 FILE* fp = (file == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, file, "rb");
2640 if (!fp) {
2641 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: base64: %s: %s\n",
2642 file.c_str(), std::strerror(errno));
2643 return 1;
2644 }
2645 std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
2646 int c;
2647 while ((c = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) bytes.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>(c));
2648 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
2649 if (decode) {
2650 std::string s(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
2651 bool ok;
2652 auto out = base64Decode(s, ok);
2653 if (!ok) { perr("base64", "invalid input"); return 1; }
2654 std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), stdout);
2655 }
2656 else {
2657 std::string out = base64Encode(bytes);
2658 if (wrap > 0) {
2659 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); i += wrap) {
2660 std::size_t take = (std::min)(wrap, out.size() - i);
2661 std::fwrite(out.data() + i, 1, take, stdout);
2662 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
2663 }
2664 }
2665 else {
2666 std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), stdout);
2667 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
2668 }
2669 }
2670 std::fflush(stdout);
2671 return 0;
2672 }

2674 // ---- cmp ------------------------------------------------------------
2675
2676 static int builtin_cmp(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2677 std::vector<std::string> files;
2678 bool quiet = false;
2679 for (const auto& a : args) {
2680 if (a == "-s" || a == "--silent" || a == "--quiet") { quiet = true; continue; }
2681 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') continue;
2682 files.push_back(a);
2683 }
2684 if (files.size() < 2) {
2685 perr("cmp", "usage: cmp [-s] FILE1 FILE2");
2686 return 2;
2687 }
2688 FILE* f1 = fopenNative(exec, files[0], "rb");
2689 if (!f1) { if (!quiet) perr("cmp", files[0] + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); return 2; }
2690 FILE* f2 = fopenNative(exec, files[1], "rb");
2691 if (!f2) { std::fclose(f1); if (!quiet) perr("cmp", files[1] + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); return 2; }
2692 long long byte = 0, line = 1;
2693 int rc = 0;
2694 while (true) {
2695 int a = std::fgetc(f1);
2696 int b = std::fgetc(f2);
2697 if (a == EOF && b == EOF) break;
2698 ++byte;
2699 if (a == EOF || b == EOF) {
2700 if (!quiet) {
2701 std::fprintf(stderr, "cmp: EOF on %s\n",
2702 (a == EOF ? files[0].c_str() : files[1].c_str()));
2703 }
2704 rc = 1;
2705 break;
2706 }
2707 if (a != b) {
2708 if (!quiet) {
2709 std::printf("%s %s differ: byte %lld, line %lld\n",
2710 files[0].c_str(), files[1].c_str(), byte, line);
2711 }
2712 rc = 1;
2713 break;
2714 }
2715 if (a == '\n') ++line;
2716 }
2717 std::fclose(f1);
2718 std::fclose(f2);
2719 return rc;
2720 }
