2722 // ---- diff (line-LCS, normal output) --------------------------------
2723
2724 static void diffEmitRange(int a, int b) {
2725 if (a == b) std::printf("%d", a);
2726 else std::printf("%d,%d", a, b);
2727 }
2728
2729 static int builtin_diff(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2730 bool brief = false;
2731 bool unified = false;
2732 int context = 3;
2733 std::vector<std::string> files;
2734 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
2735 const std::string& a = args[i];
2736 if (a == "-q" || a == "--brief") { brief = true; continue; }
2737 if (a == "-u" || a == "--unified") { unified = true; continue; }
2738 if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-U") == 0) {
2739 unified = true;
2740 try { context = std::stoi(a.substr(2)); }
2741 catch (...) {}
2742 continue;
2743 }
2744 if (a == "-U" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
2745 unified = true;
2746 try { context = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
2747 catch (...) {}
2748 continue;
2749 }
2750 if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') continue;
2751 files.push_back(a);
2752 }
2753 if (files.size() < 2) {
2754 perr("diff", "usage: diff [-q] FILE1 FILE2");
2755 return 2;
2756 }
2757 std::vector<std::string> A, B;
2758 if (!readAllLines(exec, files[0], A) || !readAllLines(exec, files[1], B)) {
2759 return 2;
2760 }
2761 if (A == B) return 0;
2762 if (brief) {
2763 std::printf("Files %s and %s differ\n",
2764 files[0].c_str(), files[1].c_str());
2765 return 1;
2766 }
2767 // LCS table.
2768 std::size_t m = A.size(), n = B.size();
2769 std::vector<std::vector<int>> L(m + 1, std::vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
2770 for (std::size_t i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
2771 for (std::size_t j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
2772 if (A[i - 1] == B[j - 1]) L[i][j] = L[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
2773 else L[i][j] = (std::max)(L[i - 1][j], L[i][j - 1]);
2774 }
2775 }
2776 // Unified-diff path: walk LCS into ' '/'-'/'+' items and group
2777 // runs of changes (with `context` lines on each side) into hunks.
2778 if (unified) {
2779 struct Item { char kind; int a, b; std::string text; };
2780 std::vector<Item> items;
2781 int ai = static_cast<int>(m), bj = static_cast<int>(n);
2782 while (ai > 0 || bj > 0) {
2783 if (ai > 0 && bj > 0 && A[ai - 1] == B[bj - 1]) {
2784 items.push_back({ ' ', ai, bj, A[ai - 1] });
2785 --ai; --bj;
2786 }
2787 else if (bj > 0 && (ai == 0 || L[ai][bj - 1] >= L[ai - 1][bj])) {
2788 items.push_back({ '+', 0, bj, B[bj - 1] });
2789 --bj;
2790 }
2791 else {
2792 items.push_back({ '-', ai, 0, A[ai - 1] });
2793 --ai;
2794 }
2795 }
2796 std::reverse(items.begin(), items.end());
2797
2798 std::printf("--- %s\n+++ %s\n",
2799 files[0].c_str(), files[1].c_str());
2800
2801 int N = static_cast<int>(items.size());
2802 int i = 0;
2803 while (i < N) {
2804 while (i < N && items[i].kind == ' ') ++i;
2805 if (i >= N) break;
2806 int change_start = i;
2807 int last_change = i;
2808 int j = i + 1;
2809 while (j < N) {
2810 if (items[j].kind != ' ') {
2811 last_change = j;
2812 ++j;
2813 }
2814 else {
2815 int run = 0, k = j;
2816 while (k < N && items[k].kind == ' ' && run < 2 * context) {
2817 ++run; ++k;
2818 }
2819 if (k < N && items[k].kind != ' ') {
2820 j = k;
2821 }
2822 else {
2823 break;
2824 }
2825 }
2826 }
2827 int hstart = (std::max)(0, change_start - context);
2828 int hend = (std::min)(N - 1, last_change + context);
2829 int a_start = 0, a_count = 0, b_start = 0, b_count = 0;
2830 for (int k = hstart; k <= hend; ++k) {
2831 if (items[k].kind != '+') {
2832 if (a_count == 0) a_start = items[k].a;
2833 ++a_count;
2834 }
2835 if (items[k].kind != '-') {
2836 if (b_count == 0) b_start = items[k].b;
2837 ++b_count;
2838 }
2839 }
2840 std::printf("@@ -%d,%d +%d,%d @@\n",
2841 a_count == 0 ? 0 : a_start, a_count,
2842 b_count == 0 ? 0 : b_start, b_count);
2843 for (int k = hstart; k <= hend; ++k) {
2844 std::putchar(items[k].kind);
2845 std::printf("%s\n", items[k].text.c_str());
2846 }
2847 i = hend + 1;
2848 }
2849 return 1;
2850 }
2851
2852 // Normal-format path: backtrack to produce a hunk list.
2853 struct Hunk { int a1, a2, b1, b2; char kind; };
2854 std::vector<Hunk> hunks;
2855 std::size_t i = m, j = n;
2856 while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
2857 if (i > 0 && j > 0 && A[i - 1] == B[j - 1]) {
2858 --i; --j;
2859 continue;
2860 }
2861 // Walk a contiguous mismatch run.
2862 std::size_t ei = i, ej = j;
2863 while (i > 0 && j > 0 && A[i - 1] != B[j - 1]) {
2864 if (L[i - 1][j] >= L[i][j - 1]) --i;
2865 else --j;
2866 }
2867 while (i > 0 && (j == 0 || L[i - 1][j] >= L[i][j])) --i;
2868 while (j > 0 && (i == 0 || L[i][j - 1] > L[i][j])) --j;
2869 int a1 = static_cast<int>(i + 1), a2 = static_cast<int>(ei);
2870 int b1 = static_cast<int>(j + 1), b2 = static_cast<int>(ej);
2871 char kind;
2872 if (a1 > a2 && b1 <= b2) { kind = 'a'; --a1; } // pure addition
2873 else if (b1 > b2 && a1 <= a2) { kind = 'd'; --b1; } // pure deletion
2874 else { kind = 'c'; }
2875 hunks.push_back({ a1, a2, b1, b2, kind });
2876 }
2877 std::reverse(hunks.begin(), hunks.end());
2878 // Emit normal-format diff: `<` lines (from A) come first, then
2879 // `---` separator on `c`, then `>` lines (from B).
2880 for (const auto& h : hunks) {
2881 diffEmitRange(h.a1, h.a2);
2882 std::putchar(h.kind);
2883 diffEmitRange(h.b1, h.b2);
2884 std::putchar('\n');
2885 if (h.kind == 'd' || h.kind == 'c') {
2886 for (int k = h.a1; k <= h.a2; ++k) {
2887 if (k - 1 < static_cast<int>(A.size())) {
2888 std::printf("< %s\n", A[k - 1].c_str());
2889 }
2890 }
2891 }
2892 if (h.kind == 'c') std::puts("---");
2893 if (h.kind == 'a' || h.kind == 'c') {
2894 for (int k = h.b1; k <= h.b2; ++k) {
2895 if (k - 1 < static_cast<int>(B.size())) {
2896 std::printf("> %s\n", B[k - 1].c_str());
2897 }
2898 }
2899 }
2900 }
2901 return 1;
2902 }
2903
2904 // ---- du -------------------------------------------------------------
2905
2906 std::uintmax_t walkSize(const fs::path& p, std::error_code& ec) {
2907 std::uintmax_t total = 0;
2908 if (fs::is_regular_file(p, ec)) {
2909 return fs::file_size(p, ec);
2910 }
2911 if (!fs::is_directory(p, ec)) return 0;
2912 fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(p,
2913 fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
2914 if (ec) return 0;
2915 for (auto cur = it; cur != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); cur.increment(ec)) {
2916 if (ec) break;
2917 std::error_code fec;
2918 if (cur->is_regular_file(fec)) {
2919 std::uintmax_t s = cur->file_size(fec);
2920 if (!fec) total += s;
2921 }
2922 }
2923 return total;
2924 }
2925
2926 static int builtin_du(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2927 bool summary = false, human = false, all = false;
2928 std::vector<std::string> paths;
2929 for (const auto& a : args) {
2930 if (a == "-s" || a == "--summarize") summary = true;
2931 else if (a == "-h" || a == "--human-readable") human = true;
2932 else if (a == "-a" || a == "--all") all = true;
2933 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') continue;
2934 else paths.push_back(a);
2935 }
2936 if (paths.empty()) paths.push_back(".");
2937 auto fmt = [&](std::uintmax_t bytes) -> std::string {
2938 if (human) return humanSize(bytes);
2939 // Default: 1024-byte blocks, like GNU du.
2940 return std::to_string((bytes + 1023) / 1024);
2941 };
2942 int rc = 0;
2943 for (const auto& p : paths) {
2944 fs::path nat = toNative(exec, p);
2945 std::error_code ec;
2946 if (!fs::exists(nat, ec)) {
2947 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: du: %s: %s\n",
2948 p.c_str(), ec.message().c_str());
2949 rc = 1;
2950 continue;
2951 }
2952 if (summary) {
2953 std::uintmax_t total = walkSize(nat, ec);
2954 std::printf("%s\t%s\n", fmt(total).c_str(), p.c_str());
2955 continue;
2956 }
2957 if (fs::is_regular_file(nat, ec)) {
2958 std::printf("%s\t%s\n",
2959 fmt(fs::file_size(nat, ec)).c_str(), p.c_str());
2960 continue;
2961 }
2962 // Walk each entry; print directory totals as we ascend.
2963 std::uintmax_t grand = 0;
2964 fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(nat,
2965 fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
2966 if (ec) { std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: du: %s\n", ec.message().c_str()); rc = 1; continue; }
2967 for (auto cur = it; cur != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); cur.increment(ec)) {
2968 if (ec) break;
2969 std::error_code fec;
2970 if (cur->is_regular_file(fec)) {
2971 std::uintmax_t s = cur->file_size(fec);
2972 if (!fec) grand += s;
2973 if (all) {
2974 std::printf("%s\t%s\n",
2975 fmt(s).c_str(), pathToUtf8(cur->path()).c_str());
2976 }
2977 }
2978 }
2979 std::printf("%s\t%s\n", fmt(grand).c_str(), p.c_str());
2980 }
2981 return rc;
2982 }
2983
2984 // ---- df -------------------------------------------------------------
2985
2986 static int builtin_df(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
2987 bool human = false;
2988 std::vector<std::string> paths;
2989 for (const auto& a : args) {
2990 if (a == "-h" || a == "--human-readable") human = true;
2991 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') continue;
2992 else paths.push_back(a);
2993 }
2994 std::vector<std::string> drives;
2995 if (paths.empty()) {
2996#ifdef _WIN32
2997 DWORD mask = GetLogicalDrives();
2998 for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
2999 if (mask & (1u << i)) {
3000 char d[4] = { static_cast<char>('A' + i), ':', '\\', 0 };
3001 drives.push_back(d);
3002 }
3003 }
3004#endif
3005 }
3006 else {
3007 for (const auto& p : paths) drives.push_back(pathToUtf8(toNative(exec, p)));
3008 }
3009 auto fmt = [&](std::uintmax_t b) -> std::string {
3010 if (human) return humanSize(b);
3011 return std::to_string(b / 1024);
3012 };
3013 std::printf("%-20s %12s %12s %12s %5s %s\n",
3014 "Filesystem", "1K-blocks", "Used", "Available", "Use%", "Mounted on");
3015 int rc = 0;
3016 for (const auto& d : drives) {
3017#ifdef _WIN32
3018 ULARGE_INTEGER avail{}, total{}, free_{};
3019 std::string root = d;
3020 if (!root.empty() && root.back() != '\\' && root.back() != '/') root.push_back('\\');
3021 if (!GetDiskFreeSpaceExA(root.c_str(), &avail, &total, &free_)) {
3022 rc = 1;
3023 continue;
3024 }
3025 std::uintmax_t t = total.QuadPart;
3026 std::uintmax_t a = avail.QuadPart;
3027 std::uintmax_t u = (t > a) ? (t - a) : 0;
3028 int pct = (t == 0) ? 0 : static_cast<int>((u * 100) / t);
3029 std::printf("%-20s %12s %12s %12s %4d%% %s\n",
3030 root.c_str(), fmt(t).c_str(), fmt(u).c_str(),
3031 fmt(a).c_str(), pct, root.c_str());
3032#else
3033 (void)d;
3034#endif
3035 }
3036 return rc;
3037 }
3038
3039 // ---- sed (s/PAT/REPL/[g] only) --------------------------------------
3040
3041 struct SedSubst {
3042 std::regex re;
3043 std::string repl;
3044 bool global = false;
3045 };
3046
3047 static bool sedParseSubst(const std::string& cmd, SedSubst& out, std::string& err) {
3048 if (cmd.size() < 4 || cmd[0] != 's') {
3049 err = "only s/PAT/REPL/[g] is supported";
3050 return false;
3051 }
3052 char delim = cmd[1];
3053 std::size_t i = 2;
3054 std::string pat;
3055 while (i < cmd.size() && cmd[i] != delim) {
3056 if (cmd[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < cmd.size()) {
3057 pat.push_back(cmd[i]);
3058 pat.push_back(cmd[i + 1]);
3059 i += 2;
3060 continue;
3061 }
3062 pat.push_back(cmd[i++]);
3063 }
3064 if (i >= cmd.size()) { err = "missing closing delimiter"; return false; }
3065 ++i; // skip delim
3066 std::string rep;
3067 while (i < cmd.size() && cmd[i] != delim) {
3068 if (cmd[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < cmd.size()) {
3069 char nx = cmd[i + 1];
3070 // Interpret common backslash escapes in the replacement.
3071 if (nx == 'n') { rep.push_back('\n'); i += 2; continue; }
3072 if (nx == 't') { rep.push_back('\t'); i += 2; continue; }
3073 if (nx >= '0' && nx <= '9') {
3074 // Backreference \N -> std::regex uses $N.
3075 rep.push_back('$');
3076 rep.push_back(nx);
3077 i += 2;
3078 continue;
3079 }
3080 rep.push_back(nx);
3081 i += 2;
3082 continue;
3083 }
3084 if (cmd[i] == '$') { rep += "$$"; ++i; continue; }
3085 rep.push_back(cmd[i++]);
3086 }
3087 if (i < cmd.size()) ++i; // skip closing delim
3088 std::string flags = (i < cmd.size()) ? cmd.substr(i) : std::string();
3089 try {
3090 out.re = std::regex(pat);
3091 }
3092 catch (const std::regex_error& e) {
3093 err = std::string("regex: ") + e.what();
3094 return false;
3095 }
3096 out.repl = rep;
3097 out.global = flags.find('g') != std::string::npos;
3098 return true;
3099 }
3100
3101 static int builtin_sed(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3102 bool quiet = false;
3103 std::string script;
3104 std::vector<std::string> files;
3105 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
3106 const std::string& a = args[i];
3107 if (a == "-n" || a == "--quiet" || a == "--silent") { quiet = true; continue; }
3108 if (a == "-E" || a == "-r" || a == "--regexp-extended") continue;
3109 if (a == "--") { ++i; while (i < args.size()) files.push_back(args[i++]); break; }
3110 if (a == "-e" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
3111 if (!script.empty()) script.push_back(';');
3112 script += args[++i];
3113 continue;
3114 }
3115 if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-e") == 0) {
3116 if (!script.empty()) script.push_back(';');
3117 script += a.substr(2);
3118 continue;
3119 }
3120 if (script.empty() && (a.empty() || a[0] != '-')) {
3121 script = a;
3122 continue;
3123 }
3124 files.push_back(a);
3125 }
3126 if (script.empty()) { perr("sed", "no script provided"); return 2; }
3127
3128 std::vector<SedSubst> cmds;
3129 {
3130 std::size_t s = 0;
3131 while (s <= script.size()) {
3132 std::size_t e = script.find(';', s);
3133 if (e == std::string::npos) e = script.size();
3134 std::string sub = script.substr(s, e - s);
3135 if (!sub.empty()) {
3136 SedSubst c;
3137 std::string err;
3138 if (!sedParseSubst(sub, c, err)) {
3139 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: sed: %s\n", err.c_str());
3140 return 2;
3141 }
3142 cmds.push_back(std::move(c));
3143 }
3144 if (e == script.size()) break;
3145 s = e + 1;
3146 }
3147 }
3148 if (files.empty()) files.push_back("-");
3149
3150 auto applyAll = [&](const std::string& line) -> std::string {
3151 std::string out = line;
3152 for (const auto& c : cmds) {
3153 if (c.global) {
3154 out = std::regex_replace(out, c.re, c.repl);
3155 }
3156 else {
3157 out = std::regex_replace(out, c.re, c.repl,
3158 std::regex_constants::format_first_only);
3159 }
3160 }
3161 return out;
3162 };
3163
3164 int rc = 0;
3165 for (const auto& f : files) {
3166 FILE* fp = (f == "-") ? stdin : fopenNative(exec, f, "rb");
3167 if (!fp) { perr("sed", f + ": " + std::strerror(errno)); rc = 1; continue; }
3168 std::string line;
3169 int c;
3170 while ((c = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF) {
3171 if (c == '\n') {
3172 std::string out = applyAll(line);
3173 if (!quiet) {
3174 std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), stdout);
3175 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
3176 }
3177 line.clear();
3178 }
3179 else line.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
3180 }
3181 if (!line.empty()) {
3182 std::string out = applyAll(line);
3183 if (!quiet) std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), stdout);
3184 }
3185 if (fp != stdin) std::fclose(fp);
3186 }
3187 std::fflush(stdout);
3188 return rc;
3189 }
3190
3191 // ---- stat -----------------------------------------------------------
3192
3193 static int builtin_stat(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3194 if (args.empty()) { perr("stat", "missing operand"); return 1; }
3195 int rc = 0;
3196 for (const auto& p : args) {
3197 if (!p.empty() && p[0] == '-') continue;
3198 std::string nat = exec.pathConv().toWin32(p);
3199 struct stat st {};
3200 if (::stat(nat.c_str(), &st) != 0) {
3201 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: stat: %s: %s\n",
3202 p.c_str(), std::strerror(errno));
3203 rc = 1;
3204 continue;
3205 }
3206 const char* type =
3207#ifdef S_ISDIR
3208 (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) ? "directory" :
3209 S_ISREG(st.st_mode) ? "regular file" : "special file");
3210#else
3211 ((st.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFDIR ? "directory" :
3212 (st.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG ? "regular file" : "special file");
3213#endif
3214 char tbuf[64];
3215 std::tm tm{};
3216#ifdef _WIN32
3217 localtime_s(&tm, &st.st_mtime);
3218#else
3219 localtime_r(&st.st_mtime, &tm);
3220#endif
3221 std::strftime(tbuf, sizeof(tbuf), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &tm);
3222 std::printf(" File: %s\n", p.c_str());
3223 std::printf(" Size: %lld\tType: %s\n",
3224 static_cast<long long>(st.st_size), type);
3225 std::printf("Access: (%04o)\n",
3226 static_cast<unsigned int>(st.st_mode & 0777));
3227 std::printf("Modify: %s\n", tbuf);
3228 }
3229 return rc;
3230 }
3231
3232 // ---- chmod (best-effort: only the readonly bit on Windows) ----------
3233
3234 static int builtin_chmod(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3235 if (args.size() < 2) {
3236 perr("chmod", "usage: chmod MODE FILE...");
3237 return 1;
3238 }
3239 const std::string& mode = args[0];
3240 int rc = 0;
3241 // Map a small set of common modes to a "writable" bool.
3242 // +w / -w / u+w / u-w / numeric (NNN where owner has w) all
3243 // drive the read-only NTFS attribute.
3244 bool writable = true;
3245 if (mode == "-w" || mode == "u-w" || mode == "a-w" || mode == "go-w") {
3246 writable = false;
3247 }
3248 else if (mode == "+w" || mode == "u+w" || mode == "a+w" || mode == "go+w") {
3249 writable = true;
3250 }
3251 else if (mode.size() == 3
3252 && std::isdigit((unsigned char)mode[0])
3253 && std::isdigit((unsigned char)mode[1])
3254 && std::isdigit((unsigned char)mode[2])) {
3255 // Owner-write bit (octal): mode[0] & 2.
3256 writable = ((mode[0] - '0') & 2) != 0;
3257 }
3258 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < args.size(); ++i) {
3259 std::string nat = exec.pathConv().toWin32(args[i]);
3260#ifdef _WIN32
3261 DWORD attr = GetFileAttributesA(nat.c_str());
3262 if (attr == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
3263 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: chmod: %s: not found\n", args[i].c_str());
3264 rc = 1;
3265 continue;
3266 }
3267 if (writable) attr &= ~FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY;
3268 else attr |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY;
3269 if (!SetFileAttributesA(nat.c_str(), attr)) {
3270 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: chmod: %s: cannot change\n", args[i].c_str());
3271 rc = 1;
3272 }
3273#else
3274 (void)nat;
3275#endif
3276 }
3277 return rc;
3278 }
3279
3280 // ---- ln [-s] [-f] TARGET LINK ---------------------------------------
3281
3282 static int builtin_ln(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3283 bool symbolic = false;
3284 bool force = false;
3285 std::vector<std::string> rest;
3286 for (const auto& a : args) {
3287 if (a == "-s" || a == "--symbolic") symbolic = true;
3288 else if (a == "-f" || a == "--force") force = true;
3289 else if (a == "-sf" || a == "-fs") { symbolic = true; force = true; }
3290 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-') continue;
3291 else rest.push_back(a);
3292 }
3293 if (rest.size() < 2) {
3294 perr("ln", "usage: ln [-s] [-f] TARGET LINK");
3295 return 1;
3296 }
3297 std::string target = rest[0];
3298 std::string link = rest[1];
3299 std::string nat_target = exec.pathConv().toWin32(target);
3300 std::string nat_link = exec.pathConv().toWin32(link);
3301#ifdef _WIN32
3302 if (force) DeleteFileA(nat_link.c_str());
3303 BOOL ok = FALSE;
3304 if (symbolic) {
3305 DWORD flags = 0;
3306 std::error_code ec;
3307 if (fs::is_directory(nat_target, ec)) flags |= 0x1; // SYMBOLIC_LINK_FLAG_DIRECTORY
3308 flags |= 0x2; // SYMBOLIC_LINK_FLAG_ALLOW_UNPRIVILEGED_CREATE
3309 ok = CreateSymbolicLinkA(nat_link.c_str(), nat_target.c_str(), flags);
3310 }
3311 else {
3312 ok = CreateHardLinkA(nat_link.c_str(), nat_target.c_str(), nullptr);
3313 }
3314 if (!ok) {
3315 DWORD err = GetLastError();
3316 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: ln: %s -> %s failed (err=%lu)\n",
3317 link.c_str(), target.c_str(), err);
3318 return 1;
3319 }
3320 return 0;
3321#else
3322 (void)nat_target; (void)nat_link;
3323 perr("ln", "not supported");
3324 return 1;
3325#endif
3326 }
3327
3328 // ---- pushd / popd / dirs --------------------------------------------
3329
3330 static std::string currentCwdPosix(Executor& exec) {
3331 std::error_code ec;
3332 auto cwd = fs::current_path(ec);
3333 if (ec) return exec.env().get("PWD");
3334 return exec.pathConv().toPosix(pathToUtf8(cwd));
3335 }
3336
3337 static void printDirStack(Executor& exec, bool numbered) {
3338 const auto& s = exec.dirStack();
3339 if (s.empty()) {
3340 std::printf("%s\n", currentCwdPosix(exec).c_str());
3341 return;
3342 }
3343 if (numbered) {
3344 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
3345 std::printf("%2zu %s\n", i, s[i].c_str());
3346 }
3347 }
3348 else {
3349 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
3350 if (i) std::fputc(' ', stdout);
3351 std::fputs(s[i].c_str(), stdout);
3352 }
3353 std::fputc('\n', stdout);
3354 }
3355 }
3356
3357 static int builtin_pushd(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3358 auto& stack = exec.dirStack();
3359 std::string cur = currentCwdPosix(exec);
3360 if (stack.empty()) stack.push_back(cur);
3361
3362 if (args.empty()) {
3363 if (stack.size() < 2) {
3364 perr("pushd", "no other directory");
3365 return 1;
3366 }
3367 std::swap(stack[0], stack[1]);
3368 }
3369 else {
3370 const std::string& target = args[0];
3371 fs::path nat = toNative(exec, target);
3372 std::error_code ec;
3373 fs::current_path(nat, ec);
3374 if (ec) { perr("pushd", target, ec); return 1; }
3375 stack.insert(stack.begin(), exec.pathConv().toPosix(
3376 pathToUtf8(fs::current_path(ec))));
3377 }
3378 // After pushd, the front of the stack must reflect new cwd.
3379 std::error_code ec;
3380 fs::current_path(toNative(exec, stack[0]), ec);
3381 if (!ec) {
3382 exec.env().set("OLDPWD", cur);
3383 exec.env().set("PWD", stack[0]);
3384 }
3385 printDirStack(exec, false);
3386 return 0;
3387 }
3388
3389 static int builtin_popd(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>&) {
3390 auto& stack = exec.dirStack();
3391 if (stack.size() < 2) {
3392 perr("popd", "directory stack empty");
3393 return 1;
3394 }
3395 std::string old = stack.front();
3396 stack.erase(stack.begin());
3397 std::error_code ec;
3398 fs::current_path(exec.pathConv().toWin32(stack[0]), ec);
3399 if (ec) { perr("popd", stack[0], ec); return 1; }
3400 exec.env().set("OLDPWD", old);
3401 exec.env().set("PWD", stack[0]);
3402 printDirStack(exec, false);
3403 return 0;
3404 }
3405
3406 static int builtin_dirs(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3407 bool numbered = false;
3408 bool clear = false;
3409 for (const auto& a : args) {
3410 if (a == "-v") numbered = true;
3411 else if (a == "-c") clear = true;
3412 else if (a == "-l") {} // long form — not implemented
3413 else if (a == "-p") numbered = false;
3414 }
3415 if (clear) {
3416 exec.dirStack().clear();
3417 return 0;
3418 }
3419 if (exec.dirStack().empty()) {
3420 exec.dirStack().push_back(currentCwdPosix(exec));
3421 }
3422 printDirStack(exec, numbered);
3423 return 0;
3424 }
3425
3426 // (`time` is now a parser-level reserved word; see parser.cpp /
3427 // Executor::execPipeline.)
3428
3429 // ---- gzip / gunzip / zcat -------------------------------------------
3430
3431 // CRC-32/IEEE 802.3 (poly 0xEDB88320). Required for gzip footer.
3432 std::uint32_t crc32Update(std::uint32_t crc, const std::uint8_t* buf, std::size_t n) {
3433 static std::uint32_t table[256];
3434 static bool inited = false;
3435 if (!inited) {
3436 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
3437 std::uint32_t c = i;
3438 for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k)
3439 c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1)) : (c >> 1);
3440 table[i] = c;
3441 }
3442 inited = true;
3443 }
3444 crc ^= 0xFFFFFFFFu;
3445 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
3446 crc = table[(crc ^ buf[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8);
3447 return crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu;
3448 }
3449
3450 // Read all bytes from a FILE*.
3451 static std::vector<std::uint8_t> readAllBytesFromFile(FILE* f) {
3452 std::vector<std::uint8_t> out;
3453 std::uint8_t buf[4096];
3454 while (true) {
3455 std::size_t n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f);
3456 if (n == 0) break;
3457 out.insert(out.end(), buf, buf + n);
3458 }
3459 return out;
3460 }
3461
3462 // Strip the gzip wrapper and return the raw DEFLATE stream offset.
3463 // `compressed_end` is set to the byte just past the DEFLATE stream
3464 // (where CRC32 + ISIZE live).
3465 static bool gzipParseHeader(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,
3466 std::size_t& deflate_start,
3467 std::size_t& deflate_end) {
3468 if (bytes.size() < 18) return false;
3469 if (bytes[0] != 0x1F || bytes[1] != 0x8B) return false;
3470 if (bytes[2] != 8) return false; // CM = deflate
3471 std::uint8_t flg = bytes[3];
3472 std::size_t i = 10; // skip MTIME, XFL, OS
3473 if (flg & 0x04) { // FEXTRA
3474 if (i + 2 > bytes.size()) return false;
3475 std::size_t xlen = bytes[i] | (bytes[i + 1] << 8);
3476 i += 2 + xlen;
3477 }
3478 if (flg & 0x08) { // FNAME
3479 while (i < bytes.size() && bytes[i] != 0) ++i;
3480 if (i < bytes.size()) ++i;
3481 }
3482 if (flg & 0x10) { // FCOMMENT
3483 while (i < bytes.size() && bytes[i] != 0) ++i;
3484 if (i < bytes.size()) ++i;
3485 }
3486 if (flg & 0x02) i += 2; // FHCRC
3487 if (i + 8 > bytes.size()) return false;
3488 deflate_start = i;
3489 deflate_end = bytes.size() - 8;
3490 return true;
3491 }
3492
3493 // Encode `data` as gzip (using stored DEFLATE blocks — valid format,
3494 // no compression). Output written to `out`.
3495 static void gzipEncodeStored(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data,
3496 std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) {
3497 // Header.
3498 out.push_back(0x1F);
3499 out.push_back(0x8B);
3500 out.push_back(0x08); // CM = deflate
3501 out.push_back(0x00); // FLG = 0
3502 for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) out.push_back(0x00); // MTIME
3503 out.push_back(0x00); // XFL
3504 out.push_back(0xFF); // OS = unknown
3505 // Stored blocks: each up to 65535 bytes.
3506 std::size_t i = 0;
3507 std::size_t n = data.size();
3508 if (n == 0) {
3509 // Empty stored final block.
3510 out.push_back(0x01);
3511 out.push_back(0x00); out.push_back(0x00);
3512 out.push_back(0xFF); out.push_back(0xFF);
3513 }
3514 while (i < n) {
3515 std::size_t take = n - i;
3516 if (take > 65535) take = 65535;
3517 bool last = (i + take >= n);
3518 out.push_back(last ? 0x01 : 0x00);
3519 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)(take & 0xFF));
3520 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((take >> 8) & 0xFF));
3521 std::uint16_t nlen = (std::uint16_t)~take;
3522 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)(nlen & 0xFF));
3523 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((nlen >> 8) & 0xFF));
3524 out.insert(out.end(), data.begin() + i, data.begin() + i + take);
3525 i += take;
3526 }
3527 // Footer: CRC32 + ISIZE (mod 2^32), little-endian.
3528 std::uint32_t crc = crc32Update(0, data.data(), data.size());
3529 std::uint32_t isize = (std::uint32_t)(data.size() & 0xFFFFFFFFu);
3530 for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((crc >> (8 * k)) & 0xFF));
3531 for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((isize >> (8 * k)) & 0xFF));
3532 }
3533
3534 static int builtin_gzip(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3535 bool decompress = false;
3536 bool to_stdout = false;
3537 bool keep = false;
3538 bool force = false;
3539 std::vector<std::string> files;
3540 for (const auto& a : args) {
3541 if (a == "-d" || a == "--decompress") decompress = true;
3542 else if (a == "-c" || a == "--stdout") to_stdout = true;
3543 else if (a == "-k" || a == "--keep") keep = true;
3544 else if (a == "-f" || a == "--force") force = true;
3545 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") { /* ignore */ }
3546 else files.push_back(a);
3547 }
3548 (void)force;
3549 auto runOne = [&](const std::string& fname) -> int {
3550 std::vector<std::uint8_t> input;
3551 if (fname == "-" || fname.empty()) {
3552 input = readAllBytesFromFile(stdin);
3553 }
3554 else {
3555 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, fname, "rb");
3556 if (!f) {
3557 perr(decompress ? "gunzip" : "gzip", fname,
3558 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3559 return 1;
3560 }
3561 input = readAllBytesFromFile(f);
3562 std::fclose(f);
3563 }
3564 std::vector<std::uint8_t> output;
3565 if (decompress) {
3566 std::size_t s, e;
3567 if (!gzipParseHeader(input, s, e)) {
3568 std::fprintf(stderr,
3569 "wbsh: gunzip: not in gzip format: %s\n", fname.c_str());
3570 return 1;
3571 }
3572 if (!inflateRaw(input.data() + s, e - s, output)) {
3573 std::fprintf(stderr,
3574 "wbsh: gunzip: invalid compressed data: %s\n", fname.c_str());
3575 return 1;
3576 }
3577 }
3578 else {
3579 gzipEncodeStored(input, output);
3580 }
3581 std::string out_path;
3582 FILE* of = stdout;
3583 if (!to_stdout && !fname.empty() && fname != "-") {
3584 if (decompress) {
3585 if (fname.size() > 3
3586 && fname.substr(fname.size() - 3) == ".gz")
3587 out_path = fname.substr(0, fname.size() - 3);
3588 else out_path = fname + ".out";
3589 }
3590 else {
3591 out_path = fname + ".gz";
3592 }
3593 of = fopenNative(exec, out_path, "wb");
3594 if (!of) {
3595 perr(decompress ? "gunzip" : "gzip", out_path,
3596 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3597 return 1;
3598 }
3599 }
3600 std::fwrite(output.data(), 1, output.size(), of);
3601 if (of != stdout) std::fclose(of);
3602 if (!to_stdout && !keep && !fname.empty() && fname != "-") {
3603 std::error_code ec;
3604 std::filesystem::remove(toNative(exec, fname), ec);
3605 }
3606 return 0;
3607 };
3608 if (files.empty()) {
3609 to_stdout = true;
3610 return runOne("");
3611 }
3612 int rc = 0;
3613 for (const auto& f : files) {
3614 int r = runOne(f);
3615 if (r) rc = r;
3616 }
3617 return rc;
3618 }
3619
3620 static int builtin_gunzip(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3621 std::vector<std::string> a = { "-d" };
3622 a.insert(a.end(), args.begin(), args.end());
3623 return builtin_gzip(exec, a);
3624 }
3625
3626 static int builtin_zcat(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3627 std::vector<std::string> a = { "-d", "-c" };
3628 a.insert(a.end(), args.begin(), args.end());
3629 return builtin_gzip(exec, a);
3630 }
3631
3632 // ---- zip / unzip ----------------------------------------------------
3633 //
3634 // Read/write ZIP archives. Uses our DEFLATE decoder for unzip and
3635 // stored entries (no compression) for zip — both produce valid
3636 // archives compatible with other tools.
3637
3638 std::uint16_t zipR16(const std::uint8_t* p) {
3639 return (std::uint16_t)(p[0] | (p[1] << 8));
3640 }
3641 std::uint32_t zipR32(const std::uint8_t* p) {
3642 return (std::uint32_t)p[0]
3643 | ((std::uint32_t)p[1] << 8)
3644 | ((std::uint32_t)p[2] << 16)
3645 | ((std::uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
3646 }
3647 static void zipW16(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::uint16_t v) {
3648 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)(v & 0xFF));
3649 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF));
3650 }
3651 static void zipW32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::uint32_t v) {
3652 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)(v & 0xFF));
3653 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF));
3654 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((v >> 16) & 0xFF));
3655 out.push_back((std::uint8_t)((v >> 24) & 0xFF));
3656 }
3657
3658 // Find ZIP end-of-central-directory record by scanning the last 64KB.
3659 static bool zipFindEOCD(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes, std::size_t& pos) {
3660 if (bytes.size() < 22) return false;
3661 std::size_t max_back = bytes.size() < 65557 ? bytes.size() : 65557;
3662 for (std::size_t i = bytes.size() - 22; i + 22 >= bytes.size() - max_back; --i) {
3663 if (zipR32(bytes.data() + i) == 0x06054B50u) { pos = i; return true; }
3664 if (i == 0) break;
3665 }
3666 return false;
3667 }
3668
3669 static int builtin_unzip(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3670 bool list_only = false;
3671 bool to_stdout = false;
3672 bool overwrite = true;
3673 std::string archive;
3674 std::vector<std::string> select;
3675 std::string outdir;
3676 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
3677 const std::string& a = args[i];
3678 if (a == "-l") list_only = true;
3679 else if (a == "-p") to_stdout = true;
3680 else if (a == "-o") overwrite = true;
3681 else if (a == "-n") overwrite = false;
3682 else if (a == "-d" && i + 1 < args.size()) outdir = args[++i];
3683 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
3684 /* ignore */
3685 }
3686 else if (archive.empty()) archive = a;
3687 else select.push_back(a);
3688 }
3689 if (archive.empty()) {
3690 perr("unzip", "missing archive name"); return 1;
3691 }
3692 (void)overwrite;
3693 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, archive, "rb");
3694 if (!f) {
3695 perr("unzip", archive,
3696 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3697 return 1;
3698 }
3699 auto bytes = readAllBytesFromFile(f);
3700 std::fclose(f);
3701 std::size_t eocd;
3702 if (!zipFindEOCD(bytes, eocd)) {
3703 perr("unzip", "not a zip archive: " + archive); return 1;
3704 }
3705 std::uint16_t total = zipR16(bytes.data() + eocd + 10);
3706 std::uint32_t cd_size = zipR32(bytes.data() + eocd + 12);
3707 std::uint32_t cd_off = zipR32(bytes.data() + eocd + 16);
3708 (void)cd_size;
3709 std::size_t p = cd_off;
3710 if (list_only) {
3711 std::printf("Archive: %s\n", archive.c_str());
3712 std::printf(" Length Date Time Name\n");
3713 std::printf("--------- ---------- ----- ----\n");
3714 }
3715 std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
3716 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < total; ++k) {
3717 if (p + 46 > bytes.size()) break;
3718 if (zipR32(bytes.data() + p) != 0x02014B50u) break;
3719 std::uint16_t method = zipR16(bytes.data() + p + 10);
3720 std::uint32_t crc = zipR32(bytes.data() + p + 16);
3721 std::uint32_t csize = zipR32(bytes.data() + p + 20);
3722 std::uint32_t usize = zipR32(bytes.data() + p + 24);
3723 std::uint16_t nlen = zipR16(bytes.data() + p + 28);
3724 std::uint16_t xlen = zipR16(bytes.data() + p + 30);
3725 std::uint16_t clen = zipR16(bytes.data() + p + 32);
3726 std::uint32_t lfh = zipR32(bytes.data() + p + 42);
3727 (void)crc;
3728 std::string name((const char*)(bytes.data() + p + 46), nlen);
3729 p += 46 + nlen + xlen + clen;
3730 if (!select.empty()) {
3731 bool found = false;
3732 for (const auto& s : select) if (s == name) { found = true; break; }
3733 if (!found) continue;
3734 }
3735 if (list_only) {
3736 std::printf("%9u ----------- ------ %s\n",
3737 (unsigned)usize, name.c_str());
3738 total_bytes += usize;
3739 continue;
3740 }
3741 if (lfh + 30 > bytes.size()) continue;
3742 if (zipR32(bytes.data() + lfh) != 0x04034B50u) continue;
3743 std::uint16_t l_nlen = zipR16(bytes.data() + lfh + 26);
3744 std::uint16_t l_xlen = zipR16(bytes.data() + lfh + 28);
3745 std::size_t data_off = lfh + 30 + l_nlen + l_xlen;
3746 if (data_off + csize > bytes.size()) continue;
3747 std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
3748 if (method == 0) {
3749 data.assign(bytes.begin() + data_off,
3750 bytes.begin() + data_off + csize);
3751 }
3752 else if (method == 8) {
3753 if (!inflateRaw(bytes.data() + data_off, csize, data)) {
3754 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: unzip: inflate failed: %s\n",
3755 name.c_str());
3756 continue;
3757 }
3758 }
3759 else {
3760 std::fprintf(stderr,
3761 "wbsh: unzip: unsupported method %d for %s\n",
3762 (int)method, name.c_str());
3763 continue;
3764 }
3765 if (to_stdout) {
3766 std::fwrite(data.data(), 1, data.size(), stdout);
3767 continue;
3768 }
3769 std::string out_path = outdir.empty() ? name : (outdir + "/" + name);
3770 if (!name.empty() && name.back() == '/') {
3771 std::error_code ec;
3772 std::filesystem::create_directories(toNative(exec, out_path), ec);
3773 continue;
3774 }
3775 std::filesystem::path pp = toNative(exec, out_path);
3776 std::error_code ec;
3777 if (pp.has_parent_path()) {
3778 std::filesystem::create_directories(pp.parent_path(), ec);
3779 }
3780 FILE* of = openUtf8(pathToUtf8(pp), "wb");
3781 if (!of) {
3782 perr("unzip", out_path,
3783 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3784 continue;
3785 }
3786 std::fwrite(data.data(), 1, data.size(), of);
3787 std::fclose(of);
3788 if (!list_only) std::printf(" inflating: %s\n", name.c_str());
3789 }
3790 if (list_only) {
3791 std::printf("--------- -------\n");
3792 std::printf("%9zu %u files\n",
3793 total_bytes, (unsigned)total);
3794 }
3795 return 0;
3796 }
3797
3798 static int builtin_zip(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
3799 bool recurse = false;
3800 std::string archive;
3801 std::vector<std::string> inputs;
3802 for (const auto& a : args) {
3803 if (a == "-r" || a == "--recurse-paths") recurse = true;
3804 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") { /* ignore */ }
3805 else if (archive.empty()) archive = a;
3806 else inputs.push_back(a);
3807 }
3808 if (archive.empty()) { perr("zip", "missing archive name"); return 1; }
3809 if (inputs.empty()) { perr("zip", "no input files"); return 1; }
3810 namespace fs = std::filesystem;
3811 std::vector<std::string> paths;
3812 for (const auto& in : inputs) {
3813 fs::path win = toNative(exec, in);
3814 std::error_code ec;
3815 if (fs::is_directory(win, ec) && recurse) {
3816 for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(win, ec);
3817 it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); it.increment(ec))
3818 {
3819 if (ec) break;
3820 if (it->is_regular_file(ec)) {
3821 std::string rel = pathToUtf8(fs::relative(it->path(), fs::current_path(ec)));
3822 std::replace(rel.begin(), rel.end(), '\\', '/');
3823 paths.push_back(rel);
3824 }
3825 }
3826 }
3827 else if (fs::is_regular_file(win, ec)) {
3828 paths.push_back(in);
3829 }
3830 }
3831 std::vector<std::uint8_t> out;
3832 struct CDEntry {
3833 std::string name;
3834 std::uint32_t crc;
3835 std::uint32_t size;
3836 std::uint32_t lfh_off;
3837 };
3838 std::vector<CDEntry> cd;
3839 for (const auto& path : paths) {
3840 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, path, "rb");
3841 if (!f) {
3842 perr("zip", path,
3843 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3844 continue;
3845 }
3846 auto data = readAllBytesFromFile(f);
3847 std::fclose(f);
3848 std::uint32_t crc = crc32Update(0, data.data(), data.size());
3849 std::uint32_t lfh_off = (std::uint32_t)out.size();
3850 // Local file header.
3851 zipW32(out, 0x04034B50u);
3852 zipW16(out, 20); // version needed
3853 zipW16(out, 0); // flags
3854 zipW16(out, 0); // method = stored
3855 zipW16(out, 0); // mod time
3856 zipW16(out, 0); // mod date
3857 zipW32(out, crc);
3858 zipW32(out, (std::uint32_t)data.size()); // comp size
3859 zipW32(out, (std::uint32_t)data.size()); // uncomp size
3860 zipW16(out, (std::uint16_t)path.size());
3861 zipW16(out, 0); // extra
3862 out.insert(out.end(), path.begin(), path.end());
3863 out.insert(out.end(), data.begin(), data.end());
3864 cd.push_back({ path, crc, (std::uint32_t)data.size(), lfh_off });
3865 std::printf(" adding: %s (stored)\n", path.c_str());
3866 }
3867 std::uint32_t cd_off = (std::uint32_t)out.size();
3868 for (const auto& e : cd) {
3869 zipW32(out, 0x02014B50u);
3870 zipW16(out, 20); // version made
3871 zipW16(out, 20); // version needed
3872 zipW16(out, 0); // flags
3873 zipW16(out, 0); // method
3874 zipW16(out, 0); // mod time
3875 zipW16(out, 0); // mod date
3876 zipW32(out, e.crc);
3877 zipW32(out, e.size); // comp size
3878 zipW32(out, e.size); // uncomp size
3879 zipW16(out, (std::uint16_t)e.name.size());
3880 zipW16(out, 0); // extra
3881 zipW16(out, 0); // comment len
3882 zipW16(out, 0); // disk
3883 zipW16(out, 0); // int attr
3884 zipW32(out, 0); // ext attr
3885 zipW32(out, e.lfh_off);
3886 out.insert(out.end(), e.name.begin(), e.name.end());
3887 }
3888 std::uint32_t cd_size = (std::uint32_t)(out.size() - cd_off);
3889 zipW32(out, 0x06054B50u);
3890 zipW16(out, 0);
3891 zipW16(out, 0);
3892 zipW16(out, (std::uint16_t)cd.size());
3893 zipW16(out, (std::uint16_t)cd.size());
3894 zipW32(out, cd_size);
3895 zipW32(out, cd_off);
3896 zipW16(out, 0);
3897 FILE* of = fopenNative(exec, archive, "wb");
3898 if (!of) {
3899 perr("zip", archive,
3900 std::error_code(errno, std::system_category()));
3901 return 1;
3902 }
3903 std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), of);
3904 std::fclose(of);
3905 return 0;
3906 }
3907
3908 // ---- bc -------------------------------------------------------------
3909
3910 // Pragmatic bc(1): parses arithmetic expressions, assignments, and
3911 // simple control flow. Uses double precision; `scale` controls
3912 // fraction display. Math library (-l) provides sqrt, s, c, e, l, a.
3913
3914 struct BcState {
3915 std::map<std::string, double> vars;
3916 int scale = 0;
3917 bool with_lib = false;
3918 bool quiet = false;
3919 bool exit_now = false;
3920 };
3921
3922 struct BcLex {
3923 const std::string& src;
3924 std::size_t i = 0;
3925 std::vector<std::string> pushback;
3926 explicit BcLex(const std::string& s) : src(s) {}
3927 void skip() {
3928 while (i < src.size() && (src[i] == ' ' || src[i] == '\t')) ++i;
3929 while (i + 1 < src.size() && src[i] == '\\' && src[i + 1] == '\n') i += 2;
3930 if (i < src.size() && src[i] == '#') {
3931 while (i < src.size() && src[i] != '\n') ++i;
3932 }
3933 }
3934 std::string next() {
3935 if (!pushback.empty()) {
3936 std::string t = pushback.back();
3937 pushback.pop_back();
3938 return t;
3939 }
3940 skip();
3941 if (i >= src.size()) return "";
3942 char c = src[i];
3943 if (std::isdigit((unsigned char)c) || c == '.') {
3944 std::size_t s = i;
3945 while (i < src.size()
3946 && (std::isdigit((unsigned char)src[i]) || src[i] == '.')) ++i;
3947 return src.substr(s, i - s);
3948 }
3949 if (std::isalpha((unsigned char)c) || c == '_') {
3950 std::size_t s = i;
3951 while (i < src.size()
3952 && (std::isalnum((unsigned char)src[i]) || src[i] == '_')) ++i;
3953 return src.substr(s, i - s);
3954 }
3955 if (c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '=' || c == '!') {
3956 if (i + 1 < src.size() && src[i + 1] == '=') {
3957 std::string r = src.substr(i, 2);
3958 i += 2; return r;
3959 }
3960 }
3961 if (c == '\n') { ++i; return ";"; }
3962 char r = src[i++]; return std::string(1, r);
3963 }
3964 std::string peek() {
3965 if (pushback.empty()) {
3966 std::string t = next();
3967 if (t.empty()) return t;
3968 pushback.push_back(t);
3969 }
3970 return pushback.back();
3971 }
3972 void unread(std::string t) { pushback.push_back(std::move(t)); }
3973 };
3974
3975 static bool bcIsName(const std::string& t) {
3976 if (t.empty()) return false;
3977 char c = t[0];
3978 if (!(std::isalpha((unsigned char)c) || c == '_')) return false;
3979 for (char x : t) if (!std::isalnum((unsigned char)x) && x != '_') return false;
3980 return true;
3981 }
3982 static bool bcIsNumber(const std::string& t) {
3983 if (t.empty()) return false;
3984 for (char c : t) {
3985 if (!std::isdigit((unsigned char)c) && c != '.') return false;
3986 }
3987 return true;
3988 }
3989
3990 // Recursive-descent expression parser/evaluator. Operates directly
3991 // on lex stream and BcState; emits the value of each top-level
3992 // expression to stdout.
3993 struct BcEval {
3994 BcLex& lex;
3995 BcState& st;
3996 BcEval(BcLex& l, BcState& s) : lex(l), st(s) {}
3997
3998 double parseExpr() { return parseAssign(); }
3999 double parseAssign() {
4000 // lookahead: NAME = expr
4001 std::string t = lex.peek();
4002 if (bcIsName(t)) {
4003 std::string n = lex.next();
4004 std::string op = lex.peek();
4005 if (op == "=" || op == "+=" || op == "-=" || op == "*="
4006 || op == "/=" || op == "%=" || op == "^=") {
4007 lex.next();
4008 double rhs = parseAssign();
4009 double cur = st.vars.count(n) ? st.vars[n] : 0.0;
4010 double v = rhs;
4011 if (op == "+=") v = cur + rhs;
4012 else if (op == "-=") v = cur - rhs;
4013 else if (op == "*=") v = cur * rhs;
4014 else if (op == "/=") v = rhs == 0 ? 0 : cur / rhs;
4015 else if (op == "%=") v = rhs == 0 ? 0 : std::fmod(cur, rhs);
4016 else if (op == "^=") v = std::pow(cur, rhs);
4017 if (n == "scale") st.scale = (int)v;
4018 else st.vars[n] = v;
4019 return v;
4020 }
4021 lex.unread(std::move(n));
4022 }
4023 return parseOr();
4024 }
4025 double parseOr() {
4026 double a = parseAnd();
4027 while (lex.peek() == "||") { lex.next(); double b = parseAnd(); a = (a != 0 || b != 0) ? 1 : 0; }
4028 return a;
4029 }
4030 double parseAnd() {
4031 double a = parseCmp();
4032 while (lex.peek() == "&&") { lex.next(); double b = parseCmp(); a = (a != 0 && b != 0) ? 1 : 0; }
4033 return a;
4034 }
4035 double parseCmp() {
4036 double a = parseAddSub();
4037 while (true) {
4038 std::string p = lex.peek();
4039 if (p == "==" || p == "!=" || p == "<" || p == "<="
4040 || p == ">" || p == ">=") {
4041 lex.next();
4042 double b = parseAddSub();
4043 bool r = false;
4044 if (p == "==") r = a == b;
4045 else if (p == "!=") r = a != b;
4046 else if (p == "<") r = a < b;
4047 else if (p == "<=") r = a <= b;
4048 else if (p == ">") r = a > b;
4049 else r = a >= b;
4050 a = r ? 1.0 : 0.0;
4051 }
4052 else break;
4053 }
4054 return a;
4055 }
4056 double parseAddSub() {
4057 double a = parseMul();
4058 while (true) {
4059 std::string p = lex.peek();
4060 if (p == "+") { lex.next(); a += parseMul(); }
4061 else if (p == "-") { lex.next(); a -= parseMul(); }
4062 else break;
4063 }
4064 return a;
4065 }
4066 double parseMul() {
4067 double a = parseExp();
4068 while (true) {
4069 std::string p = lex.peek();
4070 if (p == "*") { lex.next(); a *= parseExp(); }
4071 else if (p == "/") {
4072 lex.next();
4073 double b = parseExp();
4074 a = b == 0 ? 0 : a / b;
4075 }
4076 else if (p == "%") {
4077 lex.next();
4078 double b = parseExp();
4079 a = b == 0 ? 0 : std::fmod(a, b);
4080 }
4081 else break;
4082 }
4083 return a;
4084 }
4085 double parseExp() {
4086 double a = parseUnary();
4087 if (lex.peek() == "^") {
4088 lex.next();
4089 a = std::pow(a, parseExp());
4090 }
4091 return a;
4092 }
4093 double parseUnary() {
4094 std::string p = lex.peek();
4095 if (p == "-") { lex.next(); return -parseUnary(); }
4096 if (p == "+") { lex.next(); return parseUnary(); }
4097 if (p == "!") { lex.next(); return parseUnary() == 0 ? 1 : 0; }
4098 if (p == "++") {
4099 lex.next();
4100 std::string n = lex.next();
4101 double v = (st.vars.count(n) ? st.vars[n] : 0.0) + 1;
4102 st.vars[n] = v;
4103 return v;
4104 }
4105 if (p == "--") {
4106 lex.next();
4107 std::string n = lex.next();
4108 double v = (st.vars.count(n) ? st.vars[n] : 0.0) - 1;
4109 st.vars[n] = v;
4110 return v;
4111 }
4112 return parsePrimary();
4113 }
4114 double parsePrimary() {
4115 std::string t = lex.next();
4116 if (t.empty()) return 0;
4117 if (t == "(") {
4118 double v = parseExpr();
4119 if (lex.peek() == ")") lex.next();
4120 return v;
4121 }
4122 if (bcIsNumber(t)) {
4123 try { return std::stod(t); }
4124 catch (...) { return 0; }
4125 }
4126 if (bcIsName(t)) {
4127 if (lex.peek() == "(") {
4128 // Function call
4129 lex.next();
4130 std::vector<double> args;
4131 if (lex.peek() != ")") {
4132 args.push_back(parseExpr());
4133 while (lex.peek() == ",") { lex.next(); args.push_back(parseExpr()); }
4134 }
4135 if (lex.peek() == ")") lex.next();
4136 return callFunc(t, args);
4137 }
4138 // Postfix ++/--
4139 if (lex.peek() == "++" || lex.peek() == "--") {
4140 double cur = st.vars.count(t) ? st.vars[t] : 0.0;
4141 double nv = lex.next() == "++" ? cur + 1 : cur - 1;
4142 st.vars[t] = nv;
4143 return cur;
4144 }
4145 if (t == "scale") return st.scale;
4146 return st.vars.count(t) ? st.vars[t] : 0.0;
4147 }
4148 return 0;
4149 }
4150 double callFunc(const std::string& n, const std::vector<double>& a) {
4151 auto get0 = [&]() { return a.empty() ? 0 : a[0]; };
4152 if (n == "sqrt") return std::sqrt(get0());
4153 if (st.with_lib) {
4154 if (n == "s") return std::sin(get0());
4155 if (n == "c") return std::cos(get0());
4156 if (n == "e") return std::exp(get0());
4157 if (n == "l") return std::log(get0());
4158 if (n == "a") return std::atan(get0());
4159 }
4160 if (n == "length") {
4161 char buf[64];
4162 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.20g", get0());
4163 std::string s = buf;
4164 int c = 0;
4165 for (char x : s) if (std::isdigit((unsigned char)x)) ++c;
4166 return (double)c;
4167 }
4168 return 0;
4169 }
4170 };
4171
4172 // Suppress-output check: an expression starting with `NAME = ...`
4173 // (or `NAME op= ...`, or `++NAME` / `--NAME`) is an assignment and
4174 // bc does not print its value. We do a cheap lookahead on the
4175 // token stream before eval to decide.
4176 static bool bcStartsAssign(BcLex& lex) {
4177 // Peek up to two tokens.
4178 std::string t1 = lex.next();
4179 if (t1.empty()) { return false; }
4180 std::string t2 = lex.next();
4181 lex.unread(t2);
4182 lex.unread(t1);
4183 if (t1 == "++" || t1 == "--") return true;
4184 if (!bcIsName(t1)) return false;
4185 return t2 == "=" || t2 == "+=" || t2 == "-=" || t2 == "*="
4186 || t2 == "/=" || t2 == "%=" || t2 == "^=";
4187 }
4188
4189 static void bcEvalLine(BcLex& lex, BcState& st) {
4190 while (true) {
4191 std::string p = lex.peek();
4192 if (p.empty()) return;
4193 if (p == ";") { lex.next(); continue; }
4194 if (p == "quit" || p == "halt") {
4195 lex.next(); st.exit_now = true; return;
4196 }
4197 if (p == "if") {
4198 lex.next();
4199 if (lex.peek() == "(") lex.next();
4200 BcEval e(lex, st);
4201 double cond = e.parseExpr();
4202 if (lex.peek() == ")") lex.next();
4203 if ((bool)cond) {
4204 bcEvalLine(lex, st);
4205 }
4206 else {
4207 // Skip the controlled statement.
4208 std::string nx = lex.next();
4209 if (nx == "{") {
4210 int d = 1;
4211 while (d > 0) {
4212 std::string t = lex.next();
4213 if (t.empty()) return;
4214 if (t == "{") ++d;
4215 else if (t == "}") --d;
4216 }
4217 }
4218 else {
4219 while (!nx.empty() && nx != ";" && nx != "\n") nx = lex.next();
4220 }
4221 }
4222 continue;
4223 }
4224 if (p == "{") {
4225 lex.next();
4226 while (lex.peek() != "}" && !lex.peek().empty()) bcEvalLine(lex, st);
4227 if (lex.peek() == "}") lex.next();
4228 continue;
4229 }
4230 if (p == "}") return;
4231 bool suppress = bcStartsAssign(lex);
4232 BcEval e(lex, st);
4233 double v = e.parseExpr();
4234 if (!suppress) {
4235 if (st.scale == 0) std::printf("%lld\n", (long long)v);
4236 else std::printf("%.*f\n", st.scale, v);
4237 }
4238 if (lex.peek() == ";") lex.next();
4239 if (lex.peek().empty() || lex.peek() == "}") return;
4240 }
4241 }
4242
4243 static int builtin_bc(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4244 BcState st;
4245 std::vector<std::string> files;
4246 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4247 const std::string& a = args[i];
4248 if (a == "-l" || a == "--mathlib") { st.with_lib = true; st.scale = 20; }
4249 else if (a == "-q" || a == "--quiet") st.quiet = true;
4250 else if (a == "-e" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4251 BcLex lex(args[++i]);
4252 while (!lex.peek().empty() && !st.exit_now)
4253 bcEvalLine(lex, st);
4254 }
4255 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") { /* ignore */ }
4256 else files.push_back(a);
4257 }
4258 auto runStream = [&](FILE* f) {
4259 std::string buf;
4260 int c;
4261 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF && !st.exit_now) {
4262 buf.push_back((char)c);
4263 if (c == '\n') {
4264 BcLex lex(buf);
4265 while (!lex.peek().empty() && !st.exit_now)
4266 bcEvalLine(lex, st);
4267 buf.clear();
4268 }
4269 }
4270 if (!buf.empty() && !st.exit_now) {
4271 BcLex lex(buf);
4272 while (!lex.peek().empty() && !st.exit_now) bcEvalLine(lex, st);
4273 }
4274 };
4275 if (files.empty()) runStream(stdin);
4276 else {
4277 for (const auto& fn : files) {
4278 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, fn, "rb");
4279 if (!f) { perr("bc", fn, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); continue; }
4280 runStream(f);
4281 std::fclose(f);
4282 }
4283 }
4284 return 0;
4285 }
4286
4287 // ---- xxd ------------------------------------------------------------
4288
4289 static int builtin_xxd(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4290 bool plain = false, reverse = false;
4291 int cols = 16;
4292 std::string path;
4293 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4294 const std::string& a = args[i];
4295 if (a == "-p" || a == "--plain") plain = true;
4296 else if (a == "-r" || a == "--revert") reverse = true;
4297 else if (a == "-c" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4298 try { cols = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
4299 catch (...) {}
4300 }
4301 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4302 perr("xxd", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4303 }
4304 else if (path.empty()) path = a;
4305 }
4306 std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
4307 auto readAllBytes = [&](FILE* f) {
4308 int c; while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) bytes.push_back((unsigned char)c);
4309 };
4310 if (path.empty() || path == "-") readAllBytes(stdin);
4311 else {
4312 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, path, "rb");
4313 if (!f) { perr("xxd", path, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4314 readAllBytes(f);
4315 std::fclose(f);
4316 }
4317 if (reverse) {
4318 // Plain: just hex bytes back to binary (any whitespace allowed).
4319 // Default xxd format: "<addr>: <hex pairs> <ascii>" — we
4320 // extract the hex pairs only.
4321 std::vector<unsigned char> out;
4322 std::string line;
4323 auto flushLine = [&]() {
4324 std::string hex;
4325 if (plain) hex = line;
4326 else {
4327 auto colon = line.find(':');
4328 auto start = (colon == std::string::npos) ? 0 : colon + 1;
4329 auto two = line.find(" ", start);
4330 hex = line.substr(start, (two == std::string::npos) ? std::string::npos : two - start);
4331 }
4332 unsigned cur = 0; int half = 0;
4333 for (char c : hex) {
4334 unsigned v;
4335 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') v = c - '0';
4336 else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') v = 10 + c - 'a';
4337 else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') v = 10 + c - 'A';
4338 else continue;
4339 cur = (cur << 4) | v; half++;
4340 if (half == 2) { out.push_back((unsigned char)cur); cur = 0; half = 0; }
4341 }
4342 };
4343 for (unsigned char c : bytes) {
4344 if (c == '\n') { flushLine(); line.clear(); }
4345 else line.push_back((char)c);
4346 }
4347 if (!line.empty()) flushLine();
4348 std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), stdout);
4349 return 0;
4350 }
4351 // Forward dump.
4352 if (plain) {
4353 int per_line = (cols > 0) ? cols * 2 : 60;
4354 int n = 0;
4355 for (unsigned char c : bytes) {
4356 std::printf("%02x", c);
4357 n += 2;
4358 if (n >= per_line) { std::printf("\n"); n = 0; }
4359 }
4360 if (n) std::printf("\n");
4361 return 0;
4362 }
4363 std::size_t addr = 0;
4364 while (addr < bytes.size()) {
4365 std::size_t end = (std::min)(bytes.size(), addr + (std::size_t)cols);
4366 std::printf("%08zx:", addr);
4367 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < addr + (std::size_t)cols; ++i) {
4368 if ((i - addr) % 2 == 0) std::printf(" ");
4369 if (i < end) std::printf("%02x", bytes[i]);
4370 else std::printf(" ");
4371 }
4372 std::printf(" ");
4373 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < end; ++i) {
4374 unsigned char c = bytes[i];
4375 std::putchar((c >= 32 && c < 127) ? c : '.');
4376 }
4377 std::printf("\n");
4378 addr = end;
4379 }
4380 return 0;
4381 }
4382
4383 // ---- od -------------------------------------------------------------
4384
4385 static int builtin_od(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4386 char fmt = 'o'; // o (octal-bytes), x (hex-bytes), c (char), d (decimal)
4387 char addr_fmt = 'o';
4388 std::string path;
4389 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4390 const std::string& a = args[i];
4391 if (a == "-c") fmt = 'c';
4392 else if (a == "-x" || a == "-h") fmt = 'x';
4393 else if (a == "-d") fmt = 'd';
4394 else if (a == "-o") fmt = 'o';
4395 else if (a == "-A" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4396 const std::string& w = args[++i];
4397 if (!w.empty()) addr_fmt = w[0];
4398 }
4399 else if (a == "-t" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4400 const std::string& t = args[++i];
4401 if (!t.empty()) {
4402 char c = t[0];
4403 if (c == 'x' || c == 'd' || c == 'o' || c == 'c') fmt = c;
4404 }
4405 }
4406 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4407 perr("od", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4408 }
4409 else if (path.empty()) path = a;
4410 }
4411 std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
4412 if (path.empty() || path == "-") {
4413 int c; while ((c = std::fgetc(stdin)) != EOF) bytes.push_back((unsigned char)c);
4414 }
4415 else {
4416 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, path, "rb");
4417 if (!f) { perr("od", path, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4418 int c; while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) bytes.push_back((unsigned char)c);
4419 std::fclose(f);
4420 }
4421 constexpr std::size_t per_row = 16;
4422 std::size_t addr = 0;
4423 while (addr < bytes.size()) {
4424 switch (addr_fmt) {
4425 case 'd': std::printf("%07zu", addr); break;
4426 case 'x': std::printf("%07zx", addr); break;
4427 case 'n': break;
4428 default: std::printf("%07zo", addr); break;
4429 }
4430 std::size_t end = (std::min)(bytes.size(), addr + per_row);
4431 if (fmt == 'c') {
4432 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < end; ++i) {
4433 unsigned char b = bytes[i];
4434 const char* esc = nullptr;
4435 switch (b) {
4436 case '\0': esc = "\\0"; break;
4437 case '\a': esc = "\\a"; break;
4438 case '\b': esc = "\\b"; break;
4439 case '\t': esc = "\\t"; break;
4440 case '\n': esc = "\\n"; break;
4441 case '\v': esc = "\\v"; break;
4442 case '\f': esc = "\\f"; break;
4443 case '\r': esc = "\\r"; break;
4444 }
4445 if (esc) std::printf(" %s", esc);
4446 else if (b >= 32 && b < 127) std::printf(" %c", b);
4447 else std::printf(" %03o", b);
4448 }
4449 }
4450 else if (fmt == 'x') {
4451 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < end; ++i) std::printf(" %02x", bytes[i]);
4452 }
4453 else if (fmt == 'd') {
4454 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < end; ++i) std::printf(" %3u", bytes[i]);
4455 }
4456 else { // octal
4457 for (std::size_t i = addr; i < end; ++i) std::printf(" %03o", bytes[i]);
4458 }
4459 std::printf("\n");
4460 addr = end;
4461 }
4462 // Final address (GNU od convention).
4463 switch (addr_fmt) {
4464 case 'd': std::printf("%07zu\n", bytes.size()); break;
4465 case 'x': std::printf("%07zx\n", bytes.size()); break;
4466 case 'n': break;
4467 default: std::printf("%07zo\n", bytes.size()); break;
4468 }
4469 return 0;
4470 }
4471
4472 // ---- fold -----------------------------------------------------------
4473
4474 static int builtin_fold(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4475 int width = 80;
4476 bool by_bytes = true;
4477 bool wrap_spaces = false;
4478 std::vector<std::string> files;
4479 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4480 const std::string& a = args[i];
4481 if (a == "-b" || a == "--bytes") by_bytes = true;
4482 else if (a == "-c" || a == "--characters") by_bytes = false;
4483 else if (a == "-s" || a == "--spaces") wrap_spaces = true;
4484 else if (a == "-w" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4485 try { width = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
4486 catch (...) {}
4487 }
4488 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-w") == 0) {
4489 try { width = std::stoi(a.substr(2)); }
4490 catch (...) {}
4491 }
4492 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-" && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[1])) {
4493 try { width = std::stoi(a.substr(1)); }
4494 catch (...) {}
4495 }
4496 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4497 perr("fold", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4498 }
4499 else files.push_back(a);
4500 }
4501 (void)by_bytes; // bytes vs chars: same in the ASCII path
4502 if (width <= 0) { perr("fold", "width must be > 0"); return 1; }
4503 auto wrapLine = [&](const std::string& line) {
4504 std::size_t pos = 0;
4505 while (pos < line.size()) {
4506 std::size_t take = (std::min<std::size_t>)(width, line.size() - pos);
4507 if (wrap_spaces && take < line.size() - pos) {
4508 auto sp = line.rfind(' ', pos + take - 1);
4509 if (sp != std::string::npos && sp >= pos) take = sp - pos + 1;
4510 }
4511 std::fwrite(line.data() + pos, 1, take, stdout);
4512 std::putchar('\n');
4513 pos += take;
4514 }
4515 if (line.empty()) std::putchar('\n');
4516 };
4517 auto runOn = [&](FILE* f) {
4518 std::string buf;
4519 int c;
4520 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
4521 if (c == '\n') { wrapLine(buf); buf.clear(); }
4522 else buf.push_back((char)c);
4523 }
4524 if (!buf.empty()) wrapLine(buf);
4525 };
4526 if (files.empty() || files[0] == "-") runOn(stdin);
4527 else {
4528 for (const auto& p : files) {
4529 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, p, "rb");
4530 if (!f) { perr("fold", p, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4531 runOn(f);
4532 std::fclose(f);
4533 }
4534 }
4535 return 0;
4536 }
4537
4538 // ---- column ---------------------------------------------------------
4539
4540 static int builtin_column(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4541 bool table = false;
4542 std::string sep = " \t";
4543 std::string out_sep = " ";
4544 std::vector<std::string> files;
4545 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4546 const std::string& a = args[i];
4547 if (a == "-t" || a == "--table") table = true;
4548 else if ((a == "-s" || a == "--separator") && i + 1 < args.size()) sep = args[++i];
4549 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-s") == 0) sep = a.substr(2);
4550 else if ((a == "-o" || a == "--output-separator") && i + 1 < args.size()) out_sep = args[++i];
4551 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4552 perr("column", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4553 }
4554 else files.push_back(a);
4555 }
4556 std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> rows;
4557 auto splitFields = [&](const std::string& line) {
4558 std::vector<std::string> fields;
4559 std::string cur;
4560 for (char c : line) {
4561 if (sep.find(c) != std::string::npos) {
4562 fields.push_back(std::move(cur)); cur.clear();
4563 // Treat consecutive whitespace separators as one field break.
4564 if (sep == " \t") {
4565 while (!fields.empty() && fields.back().empty())
4566 fields.pop_back();
4567 }
4568 }
4569 else cur.push_back(c);
4570 }
4571 fields.push_back(std::move(cur));
4572 return fields;
4573 };
4574 auto runOn = [&](FILE* f) {
4575 std::string buf; int c;
4576 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
4577 if (c == '\n') { rows.push_back(splitFields(buf)); buf.clear(); }
4578 else buf.push_back((char)c);
4579 }
4580 if (!buf.empty()) rows.push_back(splitFields(buf));
4581 };
4582 if (files.empty() || files[0] == "-") runOn(stdin);
4583 else {
4584 for (const auto& p : files) {
4585 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, p, "rb");
4586 if (!f) { perr("column", p, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4587 runOn(f);
4588 std::fclose(f);
4589 }
4590 }
4591 if (!table) {
4592 for (const auto& row : rows) {
4593 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < row.size(); ++i) {
4594 if (i) std::fputs(" ", stdout);
4595 std::fputs(row[i].c_str(), stdout);
4596 }
4597 std::putchar('\n');
4598 }
4599 return 0;
4600 }
4601 // Table mode: pad each column to the widest entry.
4602 std::size_t cols = 0;
4603 for (const auto& r : rows) cols = (std::max)(cols, r.size());
4604 std::vector<std::size_t> widths(cols, 0);
4605 for (const auto& r : rows) {
4606 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < r.size(); ++i)
4607 widths[i] = (std::max)(widths[i], r[i].size());
4608 }
4609 for (const auto& r : rows) {
4610 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < r.size(); ++i) {
4611 if (i) std::fputs(out_sep.c_str(), stdout);
4612 std::fputs(r[i].c_str(), stdout);
4613 if (i + 1 < r.size()) {
4614 for (std::size_t k = r[i].size(); k < widths[i]; ++k)
4615 std::putchar(' ');
4616 }
4617 }
4618 std::putchar('\n');
4619 }
4620 return 0;
4621 }
4622
4623 // ---- expand / unexpand ----------------------------------------------
4624
4625 static int builtin_expand(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4626 int tabstop = 8;
4627 std::vector<std::string> files;
4628 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4629 const std::string& a = args[i];
4630 if ((a == "-t" || a == "--tabs") && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4631 try { tabstop = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
4632 catch (...) {}
4633 }
4634 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-t") == 0) {
4635 try { tabstop = std::stoi(a.substr(2)); }
4636 catch (...) {}
4637 }
4638 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-" && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[1])) {
4639 try { tabstop = std::stoi(a.substr(1)); }
4640 catch (...) {}
4641 }
4642 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4643 perr("expand", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4644 }
4645 else files.push_back(a);
4646 }
4647 if (tabstop <= 0) tabstop = 8;
4648 auto runOn = [&](FILE* f) {
4649 int col = 0; int c;
4650 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
4651 if (c == '\t') {
4652 int spaces = tabstop - (col % tabstop);
4653 for (int i = 0; i < spaces; ++i) std::putchar(' ');
4654 col += spaces;
4655 }
4656 else if (c == '\n') { std::putchar('\n'); col = 0; }
4657 else { std::putchar(c); ++col; }
4658 }
4659 };
4660 if (files.empty() || files[0] == "-") runOn(stdin);
4661 else {
4662 for (const auto& p : files) {
4663 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, p, "rb");
4664 if (!f) { perr("expand", p, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4665 runOn(f);
4666 std::fclose(f);
4667 }
4668 }
4669 return 0;
4670 }
4671
4672 static int builtin_unexpand(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4673 int tabstop = 8;
4674 bool all = false;
4675 std::vector<std::string> files;
4676 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4677 const std::string& a = args[i];
4678 if (a == "-a" || a == "--all") all = true;
4679 else if ((a == "-t" || a == "--tabs") && i + 1 < args.size()) {
4680 try { tabstop = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
4681 catch (...) {}
4682 }
4683 else if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-t") == 0) {
4684 try { tabstop = std::stoi(a.substr(2)); }
4685 catch (...) {}
4686 }
4687 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4688 perr("unexpand", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4689 }
4690 else files.push_back(a);
4691 }
4692 if (tabstop <= 0) tabstop = 8;
4693 auto runOn = [&](FILE* f) {
4694 std::string buf; int c;
4695 auto flush = [&]() {
4696 // Compress runs of leading spaces (or, with -a, anywhere)
4697 // into tabs at tabstop boundaries.
4698 std::size_t i = 0;
4699 int col = 0;
4700 bool past_indent = false;
4701 while (i < buf.size()) {
4702 if (!past_indent || all) {
4703 std::size_t run_start = i;
4704 int run_col = col;
4705 while (i < buf.size() && buf[i] == ' ') { ++i; ++col; }
4706 int run_len = col - run_col;
4707 if (run_len > 0) {
4708 int next_tab = ((run_col / tabstop) + 1) * tabstop;
4709 while (run_col + (next_tab - run_col) <= col) {
4710 int gap = next_tab - run_col;
4711 if (gap == 0) break;
4712 std::putchar('\t');
4713 run_col = next_tab;
4714 next_tab += tabstop;
4715 }
4716 while (run_col < col) { std::putchar(' '); ++run_col; }
4717 (void)run_start;
4718 continue;
4719 }
4720 }
4721 char ch = buf[i++];
4722 if (ch != ' ' && ch != '\t') past_indent = true;
4723 std::putchar(ch);
4724 if (ch == '\t') col = ((col / tabstop) + 1) * tabstop;
4725 else ++col;
4726 }
4727 };
4728 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
4729 if (c == '\n') { flush(); std::putchar('\n'); buf.clear(); }
4730 else buf.push_back((char)c);
4731 }
4732 if (!buf.empty()) flush();
4733 };
4734 if (files.empty() || files[0] == "-") runOn(stdin);
4735 else {
4736 for (const auto& p : files) {
4737 FILE* f = fopenNative(exec, p, "rb");
4738 if (!f) { perr("unexpand", p, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return 1; }
4739 runOn(f);
4740 std::fclose(f);
4741 }
4742 }
4743 return 0;
4744 }
4745
4746 // ---- comm -----------------------------------------------------------
4747
4748 static int builtin_comm(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4749 bool suppress[3] = { false, false, false }; // -1 -2 -3
4750 std::vector<std::string> files;
4751 for (const auto& a : args) {
4752 if (a == "-1") suppress[0] = true;
4753 else if (a == "-2") suppress[1] = true;
4754 else if (a == "-3") suppress[2] = true;
4755 else if (a == "-12" || a == "-21") { suppress[0] = suppress[1] = true; }
4756 else if (a == "-13" || a == "-31") { suppress[0] = suppress[2] = true; }
4757 else if (a == "-23" || a == "-32") { suppress[1] = suppress[2] = true; }
4758 else if (a == "-123") { suppress[0] = suppress[1] = suppress[2] = true; }
4759 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4760 perr("comm", "unknown option: " + a); return 1;
4761 }
4762 else files.push_back(a);
4763 }
4764 if (files.size() != 2) { perr("comm", "usage: comm [opts] FILE1 FILE2"); return 1; }
4765 auto loadLines = [&](const std::string& p) -> std::vector<std::string> {
4766 std::vector<std::string> out;
4767 FILE* f = (p == "-") ? stdin
4768 : fopenNative(exec, p, "rb");
4769 if (!f) { perr("comm", p, std::error_code(errno, std::system_category())); return out; }
4770 std::string buf; int c;
4771 while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
4772 if (c == '\n') { out.push_back(std::move(buf)); buf.clear(); }
4773 else buf.push_back((char)c);
4774 }
4775 if (!buf.empty()) out.push_back(std::move(buf));
4776 if (f != stdin) std::fclose(f);
4777 return out;
4778 };
4779 auto la = loadLines(files[0]);
4780 auto lb = loadLines(files[1]);
4781 auto emit = [&](int col, const std::string& s) {
4782 if (suppress[col]) return;
4783 for (int k = 0; k < col; ++k) std::putchar('\t');
4784 std::fputs(s.c_str(), stdout);
4785 std::putchar('\n');
4786 };
4787 std::size_t i = 0, j = 0;
4788 while (i < la.size() && j < lb.size()) {
4789 if (la[i] == lb[j]) { emit(2, la[i]); ++i; ++j; }
4790 else if (la[i] < lb[j]) { emit(0, la[i]); ++i; }
4791 else { emit(1, lb[j]); ++j; }
4792 }
4793 while (i < la.size()) { emit(0, la[i++]); }
4794 while (j < lb.size()) { emit(1, lb[j++]); }
4795 return 0;
4796 }
4797
4798 // ---- yes ------------------------------------------------------------
4799
4800 static int builtin_yes(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4801 std::string line;
4802 if (args.empty()) line = "y";
4803 else {
4804 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4805 if (i) line.push_back(' ');
4806 line += args[i];
4807 }
4808 }
4809 line.push_back('\n');
4810 while (true) {
4811 if (std::fwrite(line.data(), 1, line.size(), stdout) != line.size()) {
4812 return 1; // pipe closed (downstream done) — exit cleanly
4813 }
4814 }
4815 }

4817 // ---- nproc ----------------------------------------------------------
4818
4819 static int builtin_nproc(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4820 (void)args; // ignore --all / --ignore=N for this minimal impl
4821 unsigned n = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
4822 if (n == 0) n = 1;
4823 std::printf("%u\n", n);
4824 return 0;
4825 }
