4827 // ---- tput -----------------------------------------------------------
4828
4829 static int builtin_tput(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4830 if (args.empty()) return 0;
4831 auto consoleSize = [](int& cols, int& lines) -> bool {
4832#ifdef _WIN32
4833 HANDLE h = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
4834 CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO info{};
4835 if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
4836 if (!GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo(h, &info)) return false;
4837 cols = info.srWindow.Right - info.srWindow.Left + 1;
4838 lines = info.srWindow.Bottom - info.srWindow.Top + 1;
4839 return true;
4840#else
4841 cols = 80; lines = 24;
4842 return true;
4843#endif
4844 };
4845 const std::string& cap = args[0];
4846 if (cap == "cols" || cap == "columns") {
4847 int c = 80, l = 24;
4848 consoleSize(c, l);
4849 std::printf("%d\n", c);
4850 return 0;
4851 }
4852 if (cap == "lines") {
4853 int c = 80, l = 24;
4854 consoleSize(c, l);
4855 std::printf("%d\n", l);
4856 return 0;
4857 }
4858 // VT-100 escape sequences for the common attributes / motions.
4859 if (cap == "clear") { std::printf("\x1b[2J\x1b[H"); return 0; }
4860 if (cap == "reset") { std::printf("\x1b" "c"); return 0; }
4861 if (cap == "bold") { std::printf("\x1b[1m"); return 0; }
4862 if (cap == "dim") { std::printf("\x1b[2m"); return 0; }
4863 if (cap == "smul") { std::printf("\x1b[4m"); return 0; }
4864 if (cap == "rmul") { std::printf("\x1b[24m"); return 0; }
4865 if (cap == "rev") { std::printf("\x1b[7m"); return 0; }
4866 if (cap == "blink") { std::printf("\x1b[5m"); return 0; }
4867 if (cap == "sgr0" || cap == "op") { std::printf("\x1b[0m"); return 0; }
4868 if (cap == "civis") { std::printf("\x1b[?25l"); return 0; }
4869 if (cap == "cnorm") { std::printf("\x1b[?25h"); return 0; }
4870 if (cap == "el") { std::printf("\x1b[K"); return 0; }
4871 if (cap == "ed") { std::printf("\x1b[J"); return 0; }
4872 if (cap == "home") { std::printf("\x1b[H"); return 0; }
4873 if (cap == "cup" && args.size() >= 3) {
4874 int row = 0, col = 0;
4875 try { row = std::stoi(args[1]); col = std::stoi(args[2]); }
4876 catch (...) { return 1; }
4877 std::printf("\x1b[%d;%dH", row + 1, col + 1);
4878 return 0;
4879 }
4880 if ((cap == "setaf" || cap == "setf") && args.size() >= 2) {
4881 int n = 0;
4882 try { n = std::stoi(args[1]); }
4883 catch (...) { return 1; }
4884 if (n >= 0 && n < 8) std::printf("\x1b[%dm", 30 + n);
4885 else std::printf("\x1b[39m");
4886 return 0;
4887 }
4888 if ((cap == "setab" || cap == "setb") && args.size() >= 2) {
4889 int n = 0;
4890 try { n = std::stoi(args[1]); }
4891 catch (...) { return 1; }
4892 if (n >= 0 && n < 8) std::printf("\x1b[%dm", 40 + n);
4893 else std::printf("\x1b[49m");
4894 return 0;
4895 }
4896 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: tput: unknown capability: %s\n", cap.c_str());
4897 return 1;
4898 }
4899
4900 // ---- mktemp ---------------------------------------------------------
4901
4902 static int builtin_mktemp(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
4903 bool make_dir = false;
4904 bool dry_run = false;
4905 bool quiet = false;
4906 std::string template_arg;
4907 std::string tmpdir_override;
4908 bool template_from_p = false;
4909 (void)template_from_p;
4910 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
4911 const std::string& a = args[i];
4912 if (a == "-d" || a == "--directory") make_dir = true;
4913 else if (a == "-u" || a == "--dry-run") dry_run = true;
4914 else if (a == "-q" || a == "--quiet") quiet = true;
4915 else if (a == "-t") {
4916 // legacy "use TMPDIR" — already our default; ignore
4917 }
4918 else if (a == "-p" || a == "--tmpdir") {
4919 if (i + 1 < args.size()) tmpdir_override = args[++i];
4920 }
4921 else if (a.size() > 9 && a.compare(0, 9, "--tmpdir=") == 0) {
4922 tmpdir_override = a.substr(9);
4923 }
4924 else if (!a.empty() && a[0] == '-' && a != "-") {
4925 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: mktemp: unknown option: %s\n", a.c_str());
4926 return 1;
4927 }
4928 else if (template_arg.empty()) {
4929 template_arg = a;
4930 }
4931 }
4932 if (template_arg.empty()) {
4933 template_arg = make_dir ? "tmp.XXXXXXXXXX" : "tmp.XXXXXXXXXX";
4934 }
4935 // Resolve TMPDIR: explicit override > $TMPDIR > $TEMP > $TMP > /tmp.
4936 std::string base;
4937 if (!tmpdir_override.empty()) base = tmpdir_override;
4938 else if (!exec.env().get("TMPDIR").empty()) base = exec.env().get("TMPDIR");
4939 else if (!exec.env().get("TEMP").empty()) base = exec.env().get("TEMP");
4940 else if (!exec.env().get("TMP").empty()) base = exec.env().get("TMP");
4941 else base = "/tmp";
4942 // If template contains a slash, treat it as path relative to CWD.
4943 fs::path full;
4944 if (template_arg.find('/') != std::string::npos
4945 || template_arg.find('\\') != std::string::npos) {
4946 full = fs::path(toNative(exec, template_arg));
4947 }
4948 else {
4949 full = fs::path(toNative(exec, base)) / template_arg;
4950 }
4951 std::string s = pathToUtf8(full);
4952 // Find trailing run of X (must be at least 3).
4953 std::size_t end = s.size();
4954 std::size_t start = end;
4955 while (start > 0 && s[start - 1] == 'X') --start;
4956 std::size_t xcount = end - start;
4957 if (xcount < 3) {
4958 if (!quiet) std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: mktemp: too few X's in template '%s'\n",
4959 template_arg.c_str());
4960 return 1;
4961 }
4962 // Try up to a few attempts with random suffixes.
4963 static const char* alpha = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789";
4964 constexpr std::size_t alpha_n = 62;
4965 std::error_code ec;
4966 for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; ++attempt) {
4967 std::string suffix(xcount, 'X');
4968 auto t = std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
4969 unsigned long long mix = static_cast<unsigned long long>(t)
4970 ^ (static_cast<unsigned long long>(GetCurrentProcessId()) << 32)
4971 ^ static_cast<unsigned long long>(attempt) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;
4972 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < xcount; ++k) {
4973 suffix[k] = alpha[mix % alpha_n];
4974 mix = mix * 6364136223846793005ULL + 1442695040888963407ULL;
4975 }
4976 std::string candidate = s.substr(0, start) + suffix;
4977 if (dry_run) {
4978 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(candidate).c_str());
4979 return 0;
4980 }
4981 if (make_dir) {
4982 if (fs::create_directory(candidate, ec) && !ec) {
4983 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(candidate).c_str());
4984 return 0;
4985 }
4986 }
4987 else {
4988 HANDLE h = CreateFileA(candidate.c_str(),
4989 GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr,
4990 CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
4991 if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
4992 CloseHandle(h);
4993 std::printf("%s\n", exec.pathConv().toPosix(candidate).c_str());
4994 return 0;
4995 }
4996 }
4997 }
4998 if (!quiet) std::fprintf(stderr,
4999 "wbsh: mktemp: failed to create unique file from '%s'\n",
5000 template_arg.c_str());
5001 return 1;
5002 }
5003
5004 // ---- kill -----------------------------------------------------------
5005
5006 static int builtin_kill(Executor&, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
5007 int signum = 15; // SIGTERM
5008 std::vector<int> pids;
5009 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
5010 const std::string& a = args[i];
5011 if (a == "-l") {
5012 std::printf(" 1) HUP 2) INT 3) QUIT 4) ILL "
5013 "5) TRAP 6) ABRT 7) BUS 8) FPE\n"
5014 " 9) KILL 10) USR1 11) SEGV 12) USR2 "
5015 "13) PIPE 14) ALRM 15) TERM\n");
5016 return 0;
5017 }
5018 if (a == "-s" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
5019 try { signum = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
5020 catch (...) {}
5021 continue;
5022 }
5023 if (a.size() > 1 && a[0] == '-' && std::isdigit((unsigned char)a[1])) {
5024 try { signum = std::stoi(a.substr(1)); }
5025 catch (...) {}
5026 continue;
5027 }
5028 if (a == "-9" || a == "-KILL") { signum = 9; continue; }
5029 if (a == "-15" || a == "-TERM") { signum = 15; continue; }
5030 if (a == "-2" || a == "-INT") { signum = 2; continue; }
5031 if (a == "-1" || a == "-HUP") { signum = 1; continue; }
5032 try { pids.push_back(std::stoi(a)); }
5033 catch (...) {
5034 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: kill: %s: arguments must be PIDs\n", a.c_str());
5035 return 1;
5036 }
5037 }
5038 if (pids.empty()) {
5039 perr("kill", "usage: kill [-SIG] PID...");
5040 return 2;
5041 }
5042 int rc = 0;
5043#ifdef _WIN32
5044 (void)signum;
5045 for (int pid : pids) {
5046 HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE | SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, pid);
5047 if (!h) {
5048 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: kill: %d: no such process\n", pid);
5049 rc = 1;
5050 continue;
5051 }
5052 if (!TerminateProcess(h, static_cast<UINT>(128 + signum))) {
5053 std::fprintf(stderr, "wbsh: kill: %d: cannot terminate\n", pid);
5054 rc = 1;
5055 }
5056 CloseHandle(h);
5057 }
5058#else
5059 (void)pids; (void)signum;
5060#endif
5061 return rc;
5062 }
5063
5064 // ---- xargs (minimal) ------------------------------------------------
5065
5066 static int builtin_xargs(Executor& exec, const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
5067 int n_per = -1; // -1 means "all in one batch"
5068 std::vector<std::string> cmd;
5069 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
5070 const std::string& a = args[i];
5071 if (a == "-n" && i + 1 < args.size()) {
5072 try { n_per = std::stoi(args[++i]); }
5073 catch (...) { return 1; }
5074 continue;
5075 }
5076 if (a.size() > 2 && a.compare(0, 2, "-n") == 0) {
5077 try { n_per = std::stoi(a.substr(2)); }
5078 catch (...) { return 1; }
5079 continue;
5080 }
5081 if (a == "--") { for (++i; i < args.size(); ++i) cmd.push_back(args[i]); break; }
5082 cmd.push_back(a);
5083 }
5084 if (cmd.empty()) cmd.push_back("echo");
5085
5086 // Split stdin on whitespace into items.
5087 std::vector<std::string> items;
5088 std::string cur;
5089 int c;
5090 while ((c = std::fgetc(stdin)) != EOF) {
5091 if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) {
5092 if (!cur.empty()) { items.push_back(std::move(cur)); cur.clear(); }
5093 }
5094 else cur.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
5095 }
5096 if (!cur.empty()) items.push_back(std::move(cur));
5097
5098 int rc = 0;
5099 auto invoke_batch = [&](std::vector<std::string> batch) {
5100 if (batch.empty() && n_per < 0) return; // empty in single-batch mode: no-op
5101 std::vector<std::string> argv = cmd;
5102 for (auto& it : batch) argv.push_back(std::move(it));
5103 if (argv.empty()) return;
5104 if (exec.isFunction(argv[0]) || exec.isBuiltin(argv[0])) {
5105 std::vector<std::string> a(argv.begin() + 1, argv.end());
5106 int r = exec.isBuiltin(argv[0])
5107 ? exec.callBuiltin(argv[0], a)
5108 : exec.callFunction(argv[0], a);
5109 if (r != 0) rc = r;
5110 }
5111 else {
5112 // Re-run via wbsh's executeText: build a quoted string. Quote
5113 // each arg conservatively (single-quote, escape inner ').
5114 std::string line;
5115 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < argv.size(); ++k) {
5116 if (k) line.push_back(' ');
5117 line.push_back('\'');
5118 for (char ch : argv[k]) {
5119 if (ch == '\'') line += "'\\''";
5120 else line.push_back(ch);
5121 }
5122 line.push_back('\'');
5123 }
5124 int r = exec.executeText(line, "<xargs>");
5125 if (r != 0) rc = r;
5126 }
5127 };
5128
5129 if (n_per > 0) {
5130 for (std::size_t k = 0; k < items.size(); k += static_cast<std::size_t>(n_per)) {
5131 std::vector<std::string> batch;
5132 for (int j = 0; j < n_per && k + j < items.size(); ++j) {
5133 batch.push_back(items[k + j]);
5134 }
5135 invoke_batch(std::move(batch));
5136 }
5137 }
5138 else {
5139 invoke_batch(items);
5140 }
5141 return rc;
5142 }
